Unlike widely used routing heuristics that are not tied to explicit service-level objectives (SLOs) and offer limited control over latency-throughput trade-offs, we introduce a multi-objective optimization framework that formulates routing as an online linear programming with interpretable decision rewards. We apply an efficient bid-price control policy based on the online linear programming that admits requests when their SLO-weighted benefit exceeds their shadow prices. To meet millisecond decision requirements, we develop a warm-started, projected first-order updates that track the evolving dual shadow prices online with predictable runtime. We integrate our router into the Vidur simulator and demonstrate substantial improvements over standard baselines across multiple SLO regimes, including end-to-end latency, time-to-first-token, throughput, and tail performance. A big picture from our result: a science-based approach outperforms others based on heuristics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于在线线性规划和bid-price控制策略的大语言模型服务路由方法，通过暖启动投影一阶更新追踪影子价格，在满足毫秒级决策需求的同时优化多SLO目标，实验证明该科学方法优于启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务路由启发式方法未与明确的服务级别目标（SLO）挂钩，对延迟-吞吐量权衡控制有限，需要一种可解释、多目标优化的路由框架。
AI.method: 将路由问题建模为在线线性规划，采用bid-price控制策略（当SLO加权收益超过影子价格时接受请求），并开发暖启动投影一阶更新方法在线追踪影子价格以满足毫秒级决策需求。
AI.result: 在Vidur模拟器上的实验表明，该方法在端到端延迟、首个令牌时间、吞吐量和尾延迟等多个SLO指标上均显著优于标准基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于科学（优化理论）的方法在LLM服务路由中优于基于启发式的方法。

title: BiSLW: Bi-Spectral Latent Watermarking for Generative Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion-based generative models have transformed visual content synthesis, yet they remain vulnerable to unauthorized usage and lack reliable attribution methods. Existing watermarking techniques often treat latent tensors as static spatial feature maps or depend on pixel-domain modification, and most do not explicitly leverage the internal frequency structure of the latent space for dual-band redundant embedding, leaving them susceptible to the stochastic nature of diffusion and regeneration attacks. We introduce BiSLW, a trainable bi-spectral latent watermarking framework that jointly embeds aligned identity signals across complementary spectral bands of the decoded diffusion latent using learned encoders and decoders, going beyond fixed-pattern frequency approaches. We leverage the inherent frequency structure of diffusion latents to design a dual-band watermarking framework. Low-frequency components encode global semantics, while high-frequency components capture fine texture. We exploit this structure to embed watermarks across complementary spectral bands. The watermark is independently injected into both bands via learned encoders and recombined before decoding, ensuring it becomes intrinsic to the generative trajectory. Dual spectral decoders recover the watermark from each band, while a cross-band consistency constraint enforces alignment between semantic and textural embeddings. Experiments show that BiSLW achieves a strong balance between perceptual fidelity and robustness, improving PSNR by over 3 dB compared to prior latent diffusion watermarking methods while preserving near-perfect bit accuracy under aggressive regeneration and common distortions, all with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: BiSLW是一种可训练的双谱潜空间水印框架，通过在扩散潜变量的低高频波段中联合嵌入对齐的身份信号，显著提升了感知保真度和鲁棒性，PSNR提升超3dB，并在再生攻击下保持近乎完美的比特准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有水印技术将潜变量视为静态空间特征图或依赖像素域修改，未充分利用潜空间的频率结构进行双波段冗余嵌入，难以抵御扩散模型的随机性和再生攻击。
AI.method: 提出BiSLW框架，利用扩散潜变量的固有频率结构设计双波段水印：低频嵌入全局语义，高频嵌入细粒度纹理；通过可学习编码器独立注入两个波段，再组合后解码；引入跨波段一致性约束强化语义与纹理嵌入的对齐。
AI.result: 相比先前方法PSNR提升超3dB，在强再生攻击和常见失真下保持近乎完美的比特准确率，计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: BiSLW在感知质量与鲁棒性之间取得了优秀平衡，有效解决了扩散模型生成内容的水印归属与防未授权使用问题。

title: Can Dialects Be Steered Like Languages? Sparse Neurons and Distributed Directions in Arabic LLMs
summary: A key challenge in Arabic NLP is the scarcity of dialectal data relative to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), causing LLMs to overproduce MSA and struggle with dialectally accurate generation. From an interpretability perspective, this raises a fundamental question: where and how are dialectal features encoded within model internals, and can these representations be leveraged to improve dialect generation without fine-tuning? This study investigates two complementary inference-time approaches that serve simultaneously as interpretability probes and control mechanisms. First, we conduct a neuron-level analysis, identifying sparse neuron populations that encode dialect-specific features and showing that amplifying or suppressing these neurons can steer model outputs toward target dialects. Second, motivated by the entanglement of dialectal features at the single-neuron level, we apply a vector-steering approach that extracts dialect-specific activation directions and injects them during inference. Together, these methods illuminate the geometry of dialectal knowledge in Arabic LLMs and offer a principled, interpretability-grounded framework for dialect control without requiring dialect-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了两种无需微调的推理时方法（神经元级分析和向量引导），用于理解和控制阿拉伯语大语言模型中的方言特征，从而提升方言生成能力。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语NLP面临方言数据稀缺的问题，LLMs倾向于过度生成现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA），难以准确生成方言。研究者希望理解方言特征在模型内部的编码方式，并利用这些表征来改善方言生成。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的推理时方法：1）神经元级分析，识别编码方言特征的稀疏神经元群体，通过放大或抑制这些神经元来引导输出；2）向量引导方法，提取方言特定的激活方向并在推理时注入。
AI.result: 稀疏神经元群体确实编码了方言特定特征；神经元级操作和向量引导均可有效控制模型输出朝向目标方言；揭示了阿拉伯语LLM中方言知识的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于可解释性的方言控制框架，无需方言特定的微调即可实现有效的方言生成控制，同时可作为理解模型内部方言表征的探针。

title: EmoteGPT: 3D Human Facial Expressions from Natural Language Descriptions
summary: Precise control of 3D facial expressions from text is crucial for virtual avatars, animation, and human-computer interaction, yet existing text-to-3D methods jointly generate identity, expression, and texture, making fine-grained expression control difficult. We instead formulate text-driven expression synthesis as a regression problem in the disentangled parameter space of a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM). This setting, however, requires paired data linking detailed language to precise expression parameters, which are missing from existing resources. To fill this gap, we introduce Txt2Emote, a benchmark of diverse 3D facial expressions with fine-grained textual annotations obtained from GPT-4o and a high-fidelity face tracker, providing both explicit descriptions detailing facial features and implicit descriptions referencing the situational context behind the expression. Leveraging this dataset, we present EmoteGPT, a text-to-3D expression framework based on a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a dedicated <Expr> token to semantically ground expression representations, which are then decoded into 3DMM parameters. We further improve EmoteGPT by augmenting training with large-scale image-to-3DMM data, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art text-to-3D face synthesis methods on emotion recognition metrics and in perceived expressiveness. Integrated into avatar pipelines, our method enables photorealistic and stylized 3D avatars, as well as expressive 3D-consistent 2D face synthesis from textual input.

AI.tldr: 提出了Txt2Emote基准数据集和EmoteGPT框架，通过将文本到3D表情生成转化为3DMM参数空间中的回归问题，并利用多模态大语言模型实现精细的文本驱动3D面部表情控制。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到3D方法联合生成身份、表情和纹理，难以实现精细的表情控制，且缺乏从详细语言到精确表情参数的配对数据。
AI.method: 将文本驱动表情合成建模为3DMM解耦参数空间中的回归问题；利用GPT-4o和高保真面部追踪器构建Txt2Emote基准数据集；提出EmoteGPT框架，基于MLLM并引入专用<Expr>标记语义接地表情表征，再解码为3DMM参数；通过大规模图像到3DMM数据增强训练。
AI.result: 在情感识别指标和感知表现力上超越现有最先进的文本到3D面部合成方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可集成到虚拟化身管线中，实现从文本输入生成逼真和风格化3D化身以及富有表现力的3D一致2D面部合成。

title: The Remarkable Effectiveness of Providing AI Agents with Natural Language Tools: A Replication Study Validating NLT Performance Across 14 Models
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, replication study, replication of arXiv:2510.14453 findings
summary: This study independently replicates and extends the Natural Language Tools (NLT) framework of Johnson et al.~(2025), which questions the use of structured tool calling in large language model (LLM) agentic systems. We evaluated NLT across 14 models and 8,560 trials, adding newer frontier, reasoning, and open-weight models to the original set. The results confirm the core findings and add detail. NLT improves tool-calling accuracy by 14.9 percentage points overall (62.3\% versus 47.4\% structured) and reduces critical errors by 93\% (51 versus 755 errors). The gains depend on model capability: models without native tool calling, reasoning models, and smaller models gain substantially (+24.0pp to +43.1pp), while heavily optimized frontier models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) show smaller or reversed advantages. This matches recent analyses of reinforcement-learning-optimized tool use (Martinez, 2025). NLT also cuts token usage by 25.2\%. The reliability and efficiency advantages compound in recursive agentic workflows, where agents chain many tool calls across sub-agents: a structured failure triggers retries, fallback routing, and coordination overhead, while NLT avoids most of that cost at the source. This work makes three contributions: (1) the first independent validation of NLT using open-source tooling, (2) evidence that model capability moderates NLT's advantages (Chen et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025), and (3) a measurement of NLT's reliability benefit (93\% fewer errors), its most deployment-relevant property given the known fragility of structured tool calling. NLT is a practical alternative to structured tool calling, especially for production systems that value reliability over parseability.

AI.tldr: 本研究独立复现并扩展了Johnson等人(2025)提出的NLT框架，验证了其在14个模型和8560次试验中相比结构化工具调用提升了14.9个百分点的准确率、减少了93%的关键错误，并节省了25.2%的token消耗，但优势依赖于模型能力。
AI.motivation: 质疑现有LLM智能体系统中结构化工具调用的必要性，探索更可靠高效的自然语言工具调用替代方案。
AI.method: 独立复现NLT框架，在14个模型（含新前沿模型、推理模型和开源模型）上进行8560次试验，对比NLT与结构化工具调用的准确率、错误率和token消耗。
AI.result: NLT整体提升工具调用准确率14.9个百分点（62.3% vs 47.4%），减少93%关键错误（51 vs 755），节省25.2% token消耗；优势受模型能力调节，弱模型获益更大，强优化前沿模型优势较小或为负。
AI.conclusion: NLT是结构化工具调用的实用替代方案，尤其适用于重视可靠性的生产系统；模型能力是调节NLT优势的关键因素。

title: What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI
summary: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed and academic trust is built. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the final outputs of research, which is what AI so effectively simulate. Accordingly, when researchers delegate central tasks of inquiry to systems like Large Language Models, they may stop enacting these practices and, with them, lose access to the formation they provide. An individual research output generated by AI may even appear improved but the researcher behind it fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans in the loop as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through frictions, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. This practice enacts what we call second scholarship, by which we understand the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what generative AI can and cannot do. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.

AI.tldr: 本文论证生成式AI会侵蚀学术判断力和学术信任赖以形成的实践基础，提出"第二学术"概念，强调研究者需通过内隐知识、个人投入、社会化和深度阅读等不可自动化要素来维护研究的智力形成价值。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI快速渗透学术研究，但现有讨论多聚焦于输出质量而非研究过程的智力形成，作者担忧研究者若将核心任务委托给AI，会导致学术判断力和学术信任的基础被侵蚀。
AI.method: 采用哲学分析与论证方法，从知识生产的构成性条件出发，分析AI模拟研究输出的局限性，并综合内隐知识、个人承诺、社会化、深度阅读等理论资源，提出"第二学术"的概念框架。
AI.result: 揭示出AI即便在输出层面看似"改进"了研究，但研究者本人并未获得发展；论证了将人仅仅作为"提示者"或"质量检查者"不足以维系研究的智力形成功能；提出了四种不可自动化的研究要素。
AI.conclusion: 研究应回归为一种"活出的实践"，在摩擦中逐步形成判断力；提出"第二学术"作为对学术技艺的重新占有，明确哪些不可委托的事项才是研究社群必须珍视和负责的核心。

title: K9-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs on Canine-Centric Videos
summary: MLLMs have shown strong zero-shot capabilities across diverse inputs such as across images, video, audio, and text. A crucial, yet underexplored, application of these models lies in understanding and modeling animal-centric scenarios. As animals are integral to millions of households, benchmarking next-generation AI models on pet-focused tasks, ranging from recognizing distress signals to enabling responsive robotic companions, is essential for building AI systems that can work alongside us. We introduce K9-Bench, a novel benchmark focused on real-world domestic dog videos, specifically targeting canine action and interaction understanding via approximately 5000 question-answer pairs across 907 videos spanning 5 distinct task categories that test long-form, canine-centric multimodal reasoning in MLLMs. To create this dataset, we propose a scalable, VLM/LLM-powered data generation pipeline that automatically mines canine-centric videos from the web and curates QA pairs requiring fine-grained, multi-hop reasoning over canine actions and temporally extended interaction sequences. We implement bias mitigation strategies designed to eliminate biases introduced by VLMs during dataset curation. Through extensive experimentation, we find that frontier MLLMs exhibit limited zero-shot performance on canine-centric tasks: although state-of-the-art closed-source models outperform open-source counterparts, they still struggle with compositional reasoning over subtle posture and interaction cues spread over long horizons. We observe that generic chain-of-thought prompting provides only modest performance for such long-horizon reasoning. Beyond a novel dataset for canine activity analysis, K9-Bench provides a general-purpose dataset construction pipeline that can be adapted to other low-data domains for quantitative analysis. Our project website is available at: https://ogmenrobotics.github.io/K9Bench.

AI.tldr: K9-Bench是一个针对家犬视频的多模态基准测试，包含907个视频中约5000个问答对，用于评估MLLMs在犬类动作和交互理解上的零样本能力。研究发现，即使最先进的模型在这类细粒度、长时序推理任务上表现有限，通用思维链提示带来的提升也不大。
AI.motivation: 动物（尤其是宠物）场景是MLLMs的重要应用方向，但目前缺乏针对犬类动作与交互理解的系统化基准。作者希望填补这一空白，推动AI在动物行为理解上的发展。
AI.method: 提出一个可扩展的VLM/LLM驱动的数据生成流水线，自动从网络挖掘犬类视频并构建细粒度、多跳推理的QA对；同时引入偏差缓解策略消除VLM在数据构建中的偏见。最终构建了5个任务类别、907个视频、约5000个QA对的K9-Bench基准。
AI.result: 前沿MLLMs在犬类任务上零样本表现有限；闭源模型优于开源模型，但在长时序中基于细微姿态和交互线索的组合推理上仍存在困难；通用思维链提示对长程推理的提升有限。
AI.conclusion: K9-Bench不仅提供了犬类活动分析的新数据集，还提供了一个可迁移到其他低数据领域的通用数据集构建流水线，为推动MLLMs在动物行为理解上的发展奠定了基础。

title: NormWorlds-CF: Solver-Verified Counterfactual Normative Reasoning with Metamorphic-Relation GRPO
summary: Language models can reach the right normative verdict for the wrong reason. We introduce NormWorlds-CF, a solver-verified environment for counterfactual normative reasoning in executable rule worlds. Its deterministic solver produces final answers, proof and falsification certificates, argument statuses, support sets, and paired-world change labels, enabling supervision and evaluation without LLM judges. The benchmark contains staged SFT diagnostics and a compact paired-world task with 270 root families and 1080 canonical-to-variant pairs. The SFT diagnostics show that final-answer supervision is an unsafe proxy: answer-only SFT reaches perfect accuracy on answer tasks but scores zero on falsification, while proof-plus-falsification training with targeted replay reaches strong all-task accuracy. For the structured-change task, we introduce metamorphic-relation GRPO (MR-GRPO), a class-conditioned reward for GRPO that gives partial credit for relation families and solver-visible change fields. In matched 1.7B continuation experiments, MR-GRPO improves held-out relation accuracy and relation-family correctness, and reduces wrong-family error, compared to sparse and answer-only GRPO. In Qwen3-4B three-seed validation, answer-only reward improves answer-change fields but weakens relation-family structure, sparse reward preserves coarse relation labels best, and MR-GRPO delivers the strongest balanced performance across answer-change, support-change, status-change, and soft root-level metamorphic-relation metrics. These results show that verified counterfactual structure can shape post-training beyond final answers, while exact full change-record generation, invariant subtype recognition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) transfer remain open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NormWorlds-CF，一个基于可执行规则世界的反事实规范推理验证环境，并引入MR-GRPO奖励方法，证明在语言模型后训练中利用验证过的反事实结构比仅依赖最终答案监督更有效。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可能"答对但理由错"，仅用最终答案监督是危险代理，缺乏对推理过程的验证。现有方法难以提供细粒度的推理结构监督。
AI.method: 构建NormWorlds-CF环境（含确定性求解器，提供答案、证明、伪造证书、论证状态、支持集和配对世界变化标签）；设计SFT诊断和配对世界任务（270个根家族，1080个规范-变体对）；提出MR-GRPO（变质关系GRPO），一种基于类条件奖励的强化学习方法。
AI.result: 答案仅SFT在答案任务上达100%准确率，但在伪造任务上为零；证明+伪造训练配合目标回放达到强全任务准确率。MR-GRPO在1.7B实验中提升保持关系准确率和关系家族正确率，减少错误家族误差；在Qwen3-4B三种子验证中实现答案变化、支持变化、状态变化和根级变质关系指标的最佳平衡性能。
AI.conclusion: 验证过的反事实结构可以有效塑造后训练过程，超越最终答案监督；但完整变化记录生成、不变子类型识别和分布外迁移仍是开放问题。

title: PLACEMEM: Toward a Compute-Aware Memory Plane for Lifelong Agents
summary: Lifelong agents need more than larger context windows and better retrieval. They need memories that can persist, evolve, and be corrected without forcing the serving stack to recompute the same history on every turn or silently reuse stale runtime state. We present PLACEMEM as a systems position on lifelong-agent memory, instantiated by an executable control-plane prototype. The central claim is that agent memory should be represented as versioned capsules that unify semantics, provenance, validity, and reusable runtime state under one correction-aware identity. In the current prototype, capsules drive prompt-level text retrieval, KV-aware routing, and cascading invalidation over live streamed backends; prospective layer-frontier replay is intentionally framed as a deeper integration agenda rather than a claimed engine feature. We describe a vLLM-first prototype with persistent capsule state, concurrency-safe invalidation, an OpenAI-compatible routing sidecar, a typed metadata contract, and a benchmark harness that measures live first-token latency, reuse, and post-correction behavior. The result is both an executable artifact that demonstrates correction-aware control-plane behavior today and a concrete roadmap for replay-aware serving integration in future lifelong-agent systems.

AI.tldr: PLACEMEM提出了一种基于版本化胶囊（versioned capsules）的终身智能体记忆系统架构，通过控制平面原型实现了语义、溯源、有效性和可复用运行时状态的统一管理，支持纠正感知的KV缓存路由和级联失效机制。
AI.motivation: 现有终身智能体依赖更大的上下文窗口或更好的检索能力，但缺乏能够持久化、演化并在不重新计算历史或重用陈旧状态的情况下进行纠正的记忆系统。
AI.method: 提出版本化胶囊（versioned capsules）统一语义、溯源、有效性和可复用运行时状态；实现提示级文本检索、KV感知路由和级联失效机制；构建vLLM优先的原型系统，包含持久化胶囊状态、并发安全的失效机制、OpenAI兼容路由侧车、类型化元数据契约和基准测试工具。
AI.result: 实现了一个可执行的纠正感知控制平面原型，展示了实时首token延迟、缓存复用率和纠正后行为等指标的基准测试结果。
AI.conclusion: PLACEMEM既是当前可用的纠正感知控制平面原型，也为未来终身智能体系统中的重放感知服务集成提供了具体路线图。

title: S-EMBER: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Streaming Egocentric Memory Retrieval
summary: As wearable devices enable continuous first-person recording, AI assistants must reason across long time horizons to recall past experiences-a capability known as episodic memory. Current benchmarks often rely on offline evaluation with access to entire video files, failing to simulate the streaming reality of wearable intelligence. We introduce S-EMBER (Streaming Egocentric Memory Benchmark for Episodic Retrieval), a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,141 videos totaling 388 hours of organic activity captured via Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. S-EMBER formalizes grounded streaming episodic retrieval, a paradigm shift from global offline search to causal, active recall triggered by visual events in a continuous stream. We provide 9,448 QA pairs requiring manual visual proof through precise temporal localization and supporting flexible response lengths to simulate natural human-AI interaction. Our extensive benchmarking of frontier models uncovers a localization paradox: while semantic reasoning improves with parameter scale, temporal grounding precision remains a stagnant architectural bottleneck that does not benefit from brute-force increases in model size, resolution, or frame density. S-EMBER establishes a hardware-authentic foundation for developing grounded, reliable episodic memory in the next generation of wearable AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了S-EMBER，一个基于Ray-Ban Meta智能眼镜拍摄的流式第一人称视角记忆检索基准，包含3141个视频（388小时）和9448个QA对，揭示了模型存在“定位悖论”：语义推理能力随参数规模提升，但时间定位精度并不受益于模型增大、分辨率或帧率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基准大多基于离线评估（可访问完整视频），无法模拟可穿戴设备流式处理的现实场景，因此需要构建一个支持流式、因果、主动回忆的评估框架。
AI.method: 使用Ray-Ban Meta智能眼镜采集3141个第一人称视频（共388小时），构建9448个需精确时间定位和灵活回答长度的QA对，要求模型在流式输入下进行因果性回忆检索。
AI.result: 前沿模型存在“定位悖论”：语义推理随参数规模提升而改善，但时间定位精度是架构性瓶颈，不随模型大小、分辨率或帧密度的增加而提升。
AI.conclusion: S-EMBER为可穿戴AI代理的流式情景记忆建立了硬件真实的评估基础，揭示了当前模型在时间定位上的结构性问题，指明了未来研究方向。

title: TRACER: Early Failure Detection for Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: Task-oriented dialogue systems often fail before the final breakdown is obvious, but most evaluation only measures failure after the conversation has already gone wrong. We present TRACER, a method for early failure detection in task-oriented dialogue. TRACER predicts from a partial dialogue whether the full conversation will eventually fail by combining simple trajectory signals from belief-state changes with text representations of the evolving dialogue state. We evaluate the method in both oracle and generated belief-state settings, and test how well it works when only 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of the dialogue is visible. Across these settings, TRACER detects useful failure signals well before the end of the conversation and outperforms heuristic, classical, and single-stream baselines. These results suggest that early failure detection can provide a practical warning signal for dialogue systems before the interaction fully breaks down.

AI.tldr: TRACER是一种能够从部分对话中早期预测任务型对话系统最终失败的方法，结合信念状态轨迹信号和文本表示，在仅25%-100%对话可见时均优于多种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统评估通常在对话失败后才进行度量，缺乏在对话早期识别即将失败的信号，导致无法及时干预。
AI.method: 提出TRACER方法，将信念状态变化的轨迹信号与对话状态的文本表示相结合，从部分对话中预测完整对话是否会失败。
AI.result: 在25%、50%、75%、100%对话可见设置下，TRACER均能提前检测到失败信号，并优于启发式、经典和单流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 早期失败检测能够在对话完全崩溃前提供实用的预警信号，有助于提升对话系统的鲁棒性。

title: Forethought: Verifiable Reasoning from Neurosymbolic Primitive Programming
summary: Current agentic workflows usually involve decomposing user requests into sequences of tool calls with correctly resolved parameters, the results of which are processed through reasoning traces in the language model's context window. The prevailing route to improve such reasoning is test-time scaling, which trains models to search over long chains of thought; but the resulting capability is entangled in model weights, is not verifiable step-by-step, and is costly at inference. We present Forethought, a neurosymbolic reasoning system that instead treats reasoning as an explicit, verifiable program, that builds from a library of symbolic and neural primitives which are composed through a domain-specific language. The result are reasoning programs, which are concrete representations of the model's work, and as such can be inspected and modified before deployment. Instantiated as a tool-calling execution kernel and evaluated across five benchmarks, Forethought improves base-model accuracy by about 30% relative and outperforms vanilla prompting, reinforcement learning scaffolds, and prompt-evolution methods, enabling small models to match or exceed frontier models capabilities. In a direct comparison, a non-reasoning model augmented with Forethought competes with a dedicated reasoning model while requiring roughly three orders of magnitude less post-training investment, and remains model-agnostic and auditable.

AI.tldr: Forethought 是一个神经符号推理系统，将推理过程视为显式、可验证的程序，通过符号原语和神经原语组合构建推理程序，在五个基准测试中使基础模型准确率提升约30%，让小模型能够与前沿模型竞争，且训练成本降低约三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体工作流依赖测试时扩展来提升推理能力，但这种方法将能力纠缠在模型权重中，无法逐步验证，且推理成本高昂。作者希望提出一种可检查、可修改、可审计的显式推理方法。
AI.method: 提出 Forethought，一个神经符号推理系统。将推理视为显式、可验证的程序，通过领域特定语言（DSL）组合符号原语和神经原语库，生成具体的推理程序。实例化为工具调用执行内核。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试中，Forethought 使基础模型准确率相对提升约30%，优于普通提示、强化学习支架和提示进化方法。非推理模型配备 Forethought 后可与专用推理模型竞争，但后训练投资减少约三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Forethought 通过将推理显式化为可编程、可审计的程序，实现了模型无关的推理增强，在显著降低训练成本的同时提升了小模型的推理能力，为神经符号推理在智能体工作流中的应用提供了有效方案。

title: BanglaMemeEvidence: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Explanatory Evidence Detection in Bengali Memes
comment: Accepted at 6th International Conference on Innovations in Computational Intelligence and Computer Vision (ICICV 2026)
summary: Memes have become influential communication tools on social media, combining viral visuals with concise messaging to convey impactful ideas. While substantial research has examined the affective dimensions of memes, key challenges such as detecting harmful content, identifying cyberbullying, and performing accurate sentiment analysis remain critical, largely due to the need for deeper contextual understanding. In this paper, we introduce MemeEvidenceDetect, a hybrid task aimed at analyzing a meme and its contextual information to identify specific sentences that explain or elucidate its meaning and humor. To support this task, we present BanglaMemeEvidence, a curated dataset of 2,917 Bengali memes, emphasizing its significance as a resource for the Bangla language. Each meme is annotated with natural language explanations, including Meme OCR, Meme Context, and Evidence Sentences, alongside relevance scores that reflect the relationship between a meme and its corresponding annotations. To address the gap in dynamically inferring a meme's context, we propose BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, a hybrid multimodal framework that integrates textual and visual features for comprehensive meme representation. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, achieving an F1 score of 0.74. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to focus on evidence detection in Bengali memes, marking a notable step forward in the analysis of memes in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MemeEvidenceDetect任务，用于分析模因及其上下文信息以识别解释性句子。同时构建了包含2,917个孟加拉语模因的BanglaMemeEvidence数据集，并提出了多模态框架BengaliMemeEvidenceNet，在证据检测任务上取得了F1为0.74的成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有模因研究多聚焦情感维度，但在有害内容检测、网络欺凌识别和精准情感分析方面仍面临挑战，尤其在低资源语言中缺乏上下文理解的深入研究。
AI.method: 提出MemeEvidenceDetect混合任务，构建BanglaMemeEvidence数据集（含OCR文本、上下文、证据句子及相关性评分），并设计BengaliMemeEvidenceNet多模态框架融合文本与视觉特征。
AI.result: BengaliMemeEvidenceNet在证据检测任务上达到了0.74的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对孟加拉语模因证据检测的研究，为低资源语言模因分析迈出了重要一步。

title: Language models guide symbolic equation discovery by controlling search
summary: Scientific equation discovery must combine broad domain priors with strict numerical testing. Symbolic regression supplies numerical grounding but faces a combinatorial search space, whereas many language-model systems ask the model to propose or select formulas directly. We test a different division of labour. We compare role specifications in which the language model acts as equation author, candidate decider or search controller, alongside end-to-end language-model and purely numerical baselines. In the controller setting we propose here, implemented as LLM-PySR, language models specify variables, operators, transformations and search depth; symbolic regression enumerates and fits expressions; and deterministic metrics govern retention. Across 74 AI-Feynman equations and seven complex formula-recovery tasks, search control achieved the strongest observed balance of accuracy, complexity, stability and cost. On an independent battery dataset, LLM-PySR identified a compact piecewise-linear relation between early voltage-curve displacement and cycle life. The results suggest that language models should shape hypothesis exploration rather than decide which equations survive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-PySR方法，让语言模型控制搜索策略（变量、算子、变换、搜索深度），而符号回归负责方程枚举和拟合，确定性指标决定方程保留。在74个AI-Feynman方程和7个复杂公式恢复任务中，搜索控制模式在准确性、复杂度、稳定性和成本之间取得了最佳平衡。在电池数据集上，LLM-PySR发现了早期电压曲线位移与循环寿命之间的分段线性关系。
AI.motivation: 科学方程发现需要结合广泛的领域先验知识与严格的数值测试。符号回归面临组合爆炸的搜索空间，而基于语言模型的系统通常让模型直接提出或选择公式，效果有限。作者希望探索一种更好的分工方式，让语言模型专注于引导假设探索，而非决定哪些方程能保留下来。
AI.method: 作者比较了三种角色分工：语言模型作为方程作者、候选决策者、搜索控制器。在控制器设置中（LLM-PySR），语言模型负责指定变量、算子、变换和搜索深度；符号回归负责枚举和拟合表达式；确定性指标负责控制方程保留。
AI.result: 在74个AI-Feynman方程和7个复杂公式恢复任务上，搜索控制模式在准确性、复杂度、稳定性和成本之间取得了最佳平衡。在独立电池数据集上，LLM-PySR发现了一个紧凑的分段线性关系——早期电压曲线位移与循环寿命之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型应被用于塑造假设探索的方向，而非决定哪些方程能存活下来。这种分工方式能够更有效地结合领域知识和数值验证的优势。

title: Property-Constrained 3D Porous Media Reconstruction from 2D Images via Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the 87th EAGE Annual Conference & Exhibition, Aberdeen, UK, June 2026
summary: This study presents a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) framework for generating 3D porous media volumes with controlled porosity, trained exclusively on 2D thin section images. The key innovation lies in combining property-conditioned generation with 2D-to-3D reconstruction, eliminating the need for expensive 3D training data while maintaining control over petrophysical properties. The framework employs a hybrid architecture with a 3D generator and 2D discriminator, where multi-axis slice extraction enables learning 3D-consistent structures from 2D training data. Porosity labels are extracted using an Enhanced U-Net segmentation model. The methodology was demonstrated on two carbonate samples with different lithologies: dolomite-anhydrite and pure dolomite. Results show that the framework successfully generates realistic 3D volumes capturing lithological features such as anhydrite inclusions and fine crystalline textures. Porosity control achieved an $R^2$ of 0.93, with mean absolute errors of 0.019 and 0.010 for the heterogeneous and homogeneous samples, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种条件生成对抗网络(cGAN)框架，仅用2D薄片图像训练即可生成具有可控孔隙度的3D多孔介质体积，无需昂贵的3D训练数据。
AI.motivation: 传统3D多孔介质生成需要大量3D训练数据，获取成本高昂。本研究旨在消除这一瓶颈，利用易获取的2D薄片图像生成3D结构，同时保持对岩石物理属性的控制。
AI.method: 采用3D生成器与2D判别器的混合架构，通过多轴切片提取从2D训练数据中学习3D一致结构；使用Enhanced U-Net分割模型提取孔隙度标签作为条件输入。
AI.result: 成功生成了捕捉岩相特征（如硬石膏包裹体、细晶纹理）的真实3D体积；孔隙度控制的R²达0.93，异质样品MAE为0.019，均质样品MAE为0.010。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了仅用2D数据生成可控孔隙度的3D多孔介质的可行性，为节约数据成本提供了有效方案。

title: Candidate-Constrained Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LongEval-RAG: System Design and Empirical Analysis
summary: We present a candidate-constrained retrieval-augmented generation system for LongEval-RAG, where each query is associated with an organizer-provided candidate set and all retrieved evidence and final citations must remain within that set. The system combines deterministic provenance tracking with passage-based retrieval, deterministic query expansion, pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), lightweight evidence reranking, citation-aware evidence aggregation, and optional MiniLM sentence reranking. We evaluate ten pipeline variants using a primary organizer evaluation and a supplementary self-generated diagnostic protocol. The primary evaluation shows that the strongest balanced variant is rule-minilm: a rule-based chunking pipeline with query expansion, PRF, RRF, reranking, citation prior, and late MiniLM sentence selection. This variant obtains the highest BERTScore, retrieval precision, nugget coverage, and average grade among our submissions. The result suggests that the main gain does not come from more complex semantic or topic-shift chunking, but from pairing stable rule-based evidence units with sentence-level neural selection before generation. The supplementary LLM-judge evaluation remains useful for early diagnosis and additional analysis, but it emphasizes different systems than the primary gold-answer and nugget-based evaluation, highlighting the need for multi-metric RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对LongEval-RAG的候选约束检索增强生成系统，通过规则分块、查询扩展、伪相关反馈、倒数秩融合、重排序和MiniLM句子筛选的组合，在保持证据来源受限的条件下取得了最优的BERTScore、检索精度和平均评分，并发现规则分块+神经句子筛选的组合优于复杂语义分块方法。
AI.motivation: 针对LongEval-RAG任务中查询必须从给定的候选集中检索证据并生成引用的约束条件，现有RAG方法在处理严格来源受限场景时表现不足，需要设计一个既满足候选约束又能保持高质量生成的系统。
AI.method: 系统由确定性溯源追踪、基于段落的检索、确定性查询扩展、伪相关反馈、倒数秩融合、轻量级证据重排序、引文感知证据聚合和可选的MiniLM句子重排序组成。评估了十个流水线变体，主要评估使用官方指标，辅助使用LLM-judge诊断。
AI.result: 最强平衡变体是rule-minilm（规则分块+查询扩展、PRF、RRF、重排序、引文先验和MiniLM句子选择），获得了最高的BERTScore、检索精度、nugget覆盖率和平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 主要增益不来自复杂语义或主题转换分块，而是来自规则分块与生成前句子级神经选择的组合；LLM-judge评估可用于早期诊断但与基于黄金答案和nugget的评估结果不一致，强调了多指标RAG评估的必要性。

title: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
summary: While decoders have rapidly scaled, encoders have remained largely unchanged since BERT. We revisit this disparity by frozen backbone evaluation via probing. Under this lens, the representations of BERT encoders become increasingly $\textit{unexploitable}$ by frozen probes, despite improved perplexity. The misalignment originates in BERT's flat design, which couples representation learning to the token reconstruction loss. We propose $\textbf{CrossBERT}$, a two-part architecture that separates the learning of high-quality encoded representations from the rigid grounding of token reconstruction. This design further enables high masking ratios ($\ge 50\%$) and gradient collection over all tokens via a $\textit{Complementary Masking Strategy}$, respectively increasing throughput by $1.5$ to $2\times$ and sample efficiency by $2\times$. Overall, CrossBERT demonstrates monotonic scaling and superior performance on MTEB(eng, v2) and frozen GLUE benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CrossBERT提出一种两阶段架构，将表示学习与token重建解耦，在保持高性能的同时实现1.5-2倍吞吐量提升和2倍样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: BERT编码器在解码器快速发展的背景下停滞不前，其扁平设计导致表示与token重建损失耦合，使得冻探头无法充分利用学到的表示。
AI.method: 提出CrossBERT两阶段架构：(1)分离高质量编码表示学习与token重建的刚性约束；(2)采用互补掩码策略实现高掩码率(≥50%)，并对所有token收集梯度。
AI.result: 在MTEB(eng, v2)和frozen GLUE基准上表现更优，吞吐量提升1.5-2倍，样本效率提升2倍，且展现出单调缩放特性。
AI.conclusion: CrossBERT通过解耦表示学习与重建任务，有效解决了BERT表示对冻探头不可利用的问题，并带来了显著的效率和性能提升。

title: Agentic IoT: Architectures, Applications, and Challenges Toward the Internet of Agents
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, Author's preprint version. The manuscript may be revised based on peer-review feedback and publication requirements
summary: The integration of AI into Internet of Things (AIoT) systems has gradually transformed them from passive data collection infrastructures into intelligent systems capable of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, classification, forecasting, and optimization. However, most existing solutions still rely on task-specific models that infer from sensor data; thus, system-wide capabilities such as real-time reasoning, adaptive planning, autonomous coordination, learning, tool use, and contextual decision-making remain limited. This paper examines Agentic IoT as a next-generation cognitive IoT paradigm that integrates the perception, reasoning, planning, learning, and action capabilities of autonomous AI agents with cyber-physical systems. Agentic IoT aims to transform IoT from data-centric sensing and inference infrastructures into distributed cognitive agent ecosystems operating across the device/edge-fog-cloud continuum. The paper first grounds this transition as a paradigm shift and positions Agentic IoT in relation to AIoT, edge intelligence, multi-agent systems, and the Internet of Agents. It then systematically reviews current studies, presents a holistic architectural framework, discusses domain-specific application potential, and identifies key technical, operational, and research challenges together with future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentic IoT（代理型物联网）作为下一代认知物联网范式，将AI代理的感知、推理、规划、学习和行动能力与网络物理系统集成，旨在将传统数据驱动的物联网转变为分布在设备-边缘-云连续体上的分布式认知代理生态系统。
AI.motivation: 现有AIoT系统仍依赖任务特定模型进行推理，缺乏系统级的实时推理、自适应规划、自主协调、学习、工具使用和上下文决策能力，需要向更智能的代理型架构演进。
AI.method: 通过范式定位（与AIoT、边缘智能、多代理系统、代理互联网的关系梳理）、系统文献综述、提出整体架构框架、讨论领域特定应用潜力以及识别技术、操作和研究挑战。
AI.result: 形成了Agentic IoT的概念框架和架构蓝图，明确了该范式在设备/边缘/雾/云连续体上的分布式认知代理生态系统的具体形态。
AI.conclusion: Agentic IoT代表了从数据中心的感知推理基础设施向分布式认知代理生态系统的根本转变，同时指出了未来在技术、操作和研究层面的关键挑战与方向。

title: CrossHallu: Do Hallucination Signals Generalize Across Languages and Domains in Large Language Model's Internals?
summary: Recent hallucination detection techniques in large language models (LLMs) focus on directly extracting features from a model's internal representations and training a classifier on these features to detect hallucinations, demonstrating promising results. Notwithstanding this advancement, most internal-state hallucination detection techniques have been explored predominantly in English, raising the question of whether such internal signals generalize across different languages and domains. To address this gap, we present CrossHallu, the first study to evaluate the cross-lingual and cross-domain generalization of hallucination detection using internal representations from six LLMs on the generative question-answering task. We conduct a systematic Arabic <-> English evaluation using TruthfulQA, an Arabic translated version of TruthfulQA, and HalluScore. This evaluation encompasses monolingual training and testing, cross-lingual transfer, cross-domain transfer, and combined cross-lingual and cross-domain transfer. The results reveal that internal-state hallucination signals in LLMs transfer across languages and domains for most models, with cross-lingual performance highly dependent on both class separability and language alignment in the feature space, whereas cross-domain transfer within Arabic varies depending on the training and testing datasets used for the hallucination detector. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/aishaalansari57/CrossHal.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了基于LLM内部表示的幻觉检测方法在跨语言（阿拉伯语↔英语）和跨领域场景下的泛化能力，发现大多数模型的内部幻觉信号能够跨语言和跨领域迁移，但跨语言性能依赖于特征空间中的类别可分性和语言对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 现有内部状态幻觉检测技术主要针对英语，缺乏对跨语言和跨领域泛化能力的系统评估，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 在6个LLM上，使用TruthfulQA及其阿拉伯语翻译版和HalluScore进行系统性阿拉伯语↔英语评估，涵盖单语训练测试、跨语言迁移、跨领域迁移及组合迁移场景。
AI.result: 内部幻觉信号在大多数模型中可跨语言和跨领域迁移；跨语言性能取决于特征空间中的类别可分性和语言对齐；跨领域迁移效果因训练/测试数据集不同而异。
AI.conclusion: 基于内部表示的幻觉检测方法具备跨语言和跨领域的泛化潜力，但性能受特征空间结构和数据分布影响。

title: Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry
summary: Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations by prepending the same natural-language instruction $Q$ to every input $p$, where $Q$ defines the reasoning feature of interest, such as ``Can this object be found in the desert?'' or ``Is this prompt malicious?'' We measure how the instruction changes the model's internal representation using $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout point. We explore eight different MAGs. The extracted reasoning features predict the models' own world understanding and judgment, can be approximated into a single activation direction, we found that some features are more linearly represented and some less, this linear representation, which is vector steering, can change the LLMs' decisions through activation steering by injecting reasoning features. Finally, we use the same method to select the best training datasets for prompt-injection classifier probes: while similarity between ordinary activations is almost unrelated to downstream performance, RFD-based similarity achieves $94.7\%$ Top-1 and $100\%$ Top-2 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出MAG方法，通过预置自然语言指令提取大语言模型的推理特征，揭示了推理特征的可线性表示性及其在激活引导和数据集选择中的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法通常依赖人工标注的概念示例，容易引入人类偏见。本文旨在无监督地从模型激活中提取推理特征，避免人工标注的局限性。
AI.method: 提出MAG框架：对每个输入p预置相同指令Q，通过计算m(Q|p) - m(p)在单个读出点的差异来测量内部表示变化，从而提取推理特征；并探索了8种不同的MAG。
AI.result: 提取的推理特征能预测模型自身理解与判断；可近似为单一激活方向；部分特征线性表示程度不同；通过激活引导可改变LLM决策；基于RFD的相似度在提示注入分类器探针的数据集选择上达到94.7% Top-1和100% Top-2准确率。
AI.conclusion: MAG是一种有效的无监督推理特征提取方法，揭示了推理特征的可线性表示性，并在激活引导和数据集选择任务中展现出良好的应用价值。

title: When Does Resolution Help a Frozen Backbone? Global Attention at Resolution Predicts Scalable Adaptation for Camouflaged and Marine Animal Segmentation
summary: Adapting frozen vision foundation models to fine-grained segmentation now largely depends on backbone selection. Whether the backbone applies global attention to a high-resolution token set predicts whether a low-rank adapter turns resolution into accuracy. Isotropic ViTs attend globally over the full grid and keep improving with resolution; hierarchical backbones confine early attention to local windows and pool the grid before their global stages, plateauing at lower resolutions. A controlled six-backbone study establishes the pattern, and editing the backbone points to the cause: pooling keeps the benefit, removing global attention does not. The effect is specific to low-rank adaptation. Under one fixed pipeline, SALT (Side-stem, Attention-gated U-Net, Low-rank Tuning), one RGB-only pass on a strong isotropic backbone wins the best S-measure on the four data-matched camouflaged sets, and leads every marine and salient set. It reaches a new state of the art on both marine-animal benchmarks (MAS3K mIoU 0.878).

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，在低秩适配微调冻结的视觉基础模型进行细粒度分割时，采用全局注意力的各向同性ViT骨干网络比早期使用局部窗口注意力的层级骨干网络更优，并基于此设计了SALT框架，在伪装目标检测和海洋动物分割任务上达到了新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 探究冻结视觉基础模型进行细粒度分割时，骨干网络选择（尤其是注意力机制类型）对低秩适配性能的影响规律及其成因。
AI.method: 通过六种骨干网络的受控实验建立规律，编辑骨干网络验证原因（池化保留收益，移除全局注意力则消失），提出SALT（Side-stem, Attention-gated U-Net, Low-rank Tuning）统一框架。
AI.result: 各向同性ViT在低秩适配下随分辨率提高持续提升；层级骨干在低分辨率即饱和。SALT在四个伪装目标数据集上S-measure最优，海洋动物MAS3K达到mIoU 0.878新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 低秩适配的成功关键在于骨干网络是否使用全局注意力处理高分辨率token集；SALT框架证明了单次RGB推理即可取得优异性能。

title: Telescope: Improving Zero Shot Detection of LLM Generated Content By Measuring Token Repetition Probability
summary: Distinguishing Large Language Model (LLM) generated text from human writing is a critical and difficult challenge. While LLMs are trained to write like humans, we hypothesize that this training leaves an indelible mark. LLMs develop a particularly strong aversion to token repetition very early in training. This bias persists as a ''Vestigial Heuristic'' (a developmental artifact) that is activated in LLM-generated text, separating LLM from human writing. To probe this phenomenon, we introduce Telescope Perplexity, a metric that evaluates the token repetition of the model, $P(s_i | s_{1:i})$ . Our empirical investigation reveals that the Telescope Perplexity signature emerges early in pre-training, and Telescope Perplexity empirically enables highly effective zero-shot LLM detection. We show state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse datasets (including modern evaluation sets we introduce), reference models, and perturbation schemes with greater efficiency than other methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“望远镜困惑度”指标，利用LLM对token重复的先天厌恶（残留启发式）来检测LLM生成文本，在零样本检测中达到SOTA或竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 区分LLM生成文本与人类写作是一项关键且困难的挑战，现有方法效率低或需依赖参考模型。
AI.method: 提出Telescope Perplexity指标，衡量模型在token重复上的概率P(s_i|s_{1:i})，利用LLM早期训练中形成的对token重复的强烈厌恶这一“残留启发式”特征进行检测。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、参考模型和扰动方案上达到SOTA或竞争性表现，且效率优于其他方法。该特征在预训练早期即出现。
AI.conclusion: LLM对token重复的偏见是训练早期形成的不可消除的残留启发式，可有效用于零样本LLM文本检测。

title: Biological Motifs for Agentic Control
summary:
The transition of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive generators to autonomous agents has introduced significant challenges in reliability, security, and state management. Current agentic architectures are often constructed ad-hoc, prone to hallucination cascades, infinite loops, and prompt injection attacks. This paper argues that many of these failure modes can be analyzed using control motifs long studied in systems biology, provided the comparison is made at the level of typed interfaces and coordination structure rather than literal biological mechanism.
  We develop a typed interface correspondence between Gene Regulatory Networks and agentic software systems using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams. Five biological motifs are mapped to composable software design patterns: Coherent Feed-Forward Loops for noise suppression, Adaptive Immunity for layered security, Mitochondrial Signaling for resource governance, Endosymbiosis for neuro-symbolic integration, and Morphogen Diffusion for spatially varying coordination. An epistemic topology layer derives Kripke-style knowledge operators from the wiring diagram's observation structure and proves four predictive theorems for multi-agent scaling.
  The core contributions are: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed syntax for agent composition with provable error suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology with four theorems (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, and tool density scaling) whose qualitative predictions are consistent with published multi-agent benchmarks; and (3) a six-layer progression from structure through development, grounded in autonomous learning frameworks and convergence proxies from the empirical literature. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples illustrates practical feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基因调控网络的五类生物控制基序（前馈环、适应性免疫、线粒体信号、内共生、形态素扩散）映射为智能体软件设计模式，通过多项式函子与接线图建立类型化接口对应，构建了Agentic Operad组合语法、认知拓扑学及六层发展框架，并提供了含1,813项测试的参考实现。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体架构存在幻觉级联、无限循环、提示注入等系统性故障，缺乏形式化的可靠性保障。作者认为这些故障模式可与系统生物学中的控制基序进行类比分析，但需在类型化接口与协调结构层面而非字面生物机制层面进行比较。
AI.method: (1) 利用多项式函子与接线图建立基因调控网络与智能体软件系统的类型化接口对应；(2) 将五种生物基序映射为可组合的软件设计模式；(3) 构建认知拓扑层，从接线图观测结构导出Kripke式知识算子；(4) 提出Agentic Operad类型化组合语法；(5) 设计六层发展框架。
AI.result: (1) 提出Agentic Operad，支持可证明误差抑制边界的前馈拓扑组合语法；(2) 导出四个预测性定理（误差放大、序列惩罚、并行加速、工具密度缩放），定性预测与已发表的多智能体基准一致；(3) 构建基于自主学习框架与收敛代理的六层递进框架；(4) 提供含1,813项测试和116个示例的参考实现。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了系统生物学控制基序可为LLM智能体系统的可靠性与可扩展性设计提供形式化工具，Agentic Operad与认知拓扑学为智能体组合提供了可证明的保证，六层框架为实际部署提供了发展路径。

title: RayTun3R: Online Camera Adaptation in 3D Foundation Models
summary: Recent 3D foundation models, such as DUSt3R, MASt3R, VGGT, $π^3$, and Depth Anything 3, provide strong feed-forward depth and pose estimates on pinhole imagery, but degrade sharply under fisheye camera geometry. We show that this failure is partly caused by a pinhole camera bias in the positional encodings of pretrained 3D foundation models, and propose RayTun3R, a lightweight camera adaptation approach. It keeps the pretrained network fixed and adapts only lightweight components tied to token position and camera geometry. RayTun3R learns parameter-efficient residual corrections to absolute and rotary positional encodings, together with parameter-free tokenization and corrections to prediction-grid coordinates that remove residual pinhole assumptions. The resulting adapter contains only 10,752 trainable parameters and can be learned from a short temporal segment using geometric losses. Once adapted, RayTun3R transfers effectively to the remaining frames of the sequence without incurring additional runtime costs. Across diverse fisheye datasets with fields of view from $110^\circ$ to $200^\circ$, our adapter reduces rotation error by $2$-$12\times$ relative to the unadapted model, outperforms LoRA while using $\sim\!14\times$ fewer trainable parameters, improves pose over adaptation-free baselines while avoiding their multi-view inference cost, and remains competitive on depth accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出RayTun3R，一种轻量级相机适配方法，通过仅调整位置编码（10,752个可训练参数）来消除3D基础模型对针孔相机的偏置，使其能有效处理鱼眼图像，在110°-200°视场下旋转误差降低2-12倍。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型（如DUSt3R、MASt3R等）在针孔图像上表现优异，但在鱼眼相机几何下性能急剧下降，原因是预训练模型的位置编码存在针孔相机偏置。
AI.method: 保持预训练网络固定，仅适配与标记位置和相机几何相关的轻量组件：学习参数高效的绝对和旋转位置编码残差修正，结合无参数的标记化和预测网格坐标修正，以消除残留的针孔假设。
AI.result: 仅10,752个可训练参数；在110°-200°视场的鱼眼数据集上，旋转误差降低2-12倍；相比LoRA使用约14倍更少的参数；无需多视图推理成本即可提升姿态估计性能；深度精度保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RayTun3R通过轻量级适配有效解决了3D基础模型在鱼眼相机下的性能退化问题，具有高参数效率、良好的迁移性和零额外推理成本的优势。

title: Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective paradigm for improving large language model agents on long-horizon interactive tasks. To obtain finer-grained policy updates than trajectory-level optimization, recent work has moved toward step-level group-based RL, where intermediate steps are grouped and compared within a rollout batch. However, step-level advantage estimation is sensitive to how groups are formed: grouping by broad state keys improves coverage but may compare actions taken under different histories, while enforcing historical consistency yields fairer comparisons at the cost of fragmented groups and missing peer-comparison signal. In this paper, we propose ProGPO (Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization), a learned-critic-free method for context-consistent step-level learning. ProGPO keeps exact-prefix action comparison, and complements sparse peer comparisons with transition credit derived from rollout-based state potentials. To estimate these potentials reliably, ProGPO combines semantic expansion with inverse-variance fusion across history depths. We evaluate ProGPO on two challenging agentic tasks, ALFWorld and WebShop, with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Results show that ProGPO improves over matched agentic RL baselines under comparable computational overhead, and additional Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct experiments further test the scalability of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: ProGPO提出了一种无需学习评论员的步骤级组策略优化方法，通过保留精确前缀动作比较和基于滚动的状态势能融合，解决了步骤级组RL中分组敏感性问题，在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有步骤级组RL方法中，优势估计对分组方式高度敏感：按状态键分组覆盖面广但比较历史不一致，保持历史一致性则分组碎片化且缺乏同行比较信号。需要一种兼顾覆盖性和公平性的方法。
AI.method: ProGPO保留精确前缀动作比较，利用基于滚动的状态势能补充稀疏的同行比较。势能估计结合语义扩展和跨历史深度的逆方差融合，无需学习评论员。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct评估，ProGPO在相当计算开销下优于匹配的智能体RL基线，并展现了良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: ProGPO通过无评论员的势能估计机制，有效解决了步骤级组RL中的分组矛盾，为长程交互任务提供了更稳定的策略优化方案。

title: Global Pose Control for Generative View Synthesis in Normalized Object Coordinate Space
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page https://lizb6626.github.io/GlobalNVS/
summary: Novel View Synthesis (NVS) enables the generation of unseen views of a scene from a single or multiple images, allowing users to freely explore an object from any viewpoint. Despite the recent impressive qualitative improvements of generative models for this task, existing methods struggle to provide global and intuitive control of target viewpoints because they either use input-relative camera poses or are limited to generating sparse global views. This lack of global pose control severely limits the number of downstream tasks potentially enabled by NVS. To address this limitation, we propose a novel approach for precise camera control in a customizable Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS), requiring single or few unposed images. Our method operates solely on the absolute camera pose of the target view in NOCS, eliminating the need for a relative world frame or camera poses of the input images. Unlike previous methods that treat NVS as a standalone generation task, we formulate it as an image editing problem and build upon state-of-the-art editing models to leverage their superior generalization capability. Camera information is injected as dedicated camera tokens via an in-context multi-modal conditioning strategy. To alleviate the inherent ambiguity of NOCS, we incorporate text descriptions that explicitly define the object's canonical coordinate frame, which also enhances generalization to unseen object categories. Furthermore, we curate a high-quality dataset with consistently aligned orientations and corresponding NOCS text definitions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method robustly generates novel views with accurate and consistent orientations from arbitrary unposed images across diverse categories, achieving state-of-the-art image quality and fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自定义归一化物体坐标空间（NOCS）的新视图合成方法，通过将NVS重新定义为图像编辑问题，利用绝对相机位姿和文本描述实现精准的全局视角控制，在无位姿的单张或少量图像上取得了SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有NVS方法缺乏全局且直观的视角控制能力（依赖输入的相对相机位姿或只能生成稀疏全局视图），严重限制了其下游应用场景。
AI.method: 1) 在自定义NOCS中使用绝对相机位姿，无需输入图像位姿或相对世界坐标系；2) 将NVS重新表述为图像编辑问题，基于先进编辑模型；3) 通过上下文多模态条件注入专用相机token；4) 引入文本描述定义物体规范坐标系以消除NOCS歧义；5) 构建高质量且方向对齐的数据集。
AI.result: 在多样类别和任意无位姿图像上，该方法能稳健生成视角准确且一致的图像，在图像质量和保真度上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过NOCS绝对位姿控制与图像编辑框架的结合，有效解决了NVS中全局视角控制缺失的问题，并展现出对未见类别的泛化能力。

title: Beyond Multilingual Averages: MTEB-PT, a Benchmark for Portuguese Sentence Encoders
comment: Accepted at BRACIS 2026 - 36th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems
summary: Portuguese remains underrepresented in text embedding evaluation, despite being one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. As a result, embedding models are often selected based on English or multilingual metrics, while their effectiveness in Portuguese remains unclear. We present MTEB-PT, a Portuguese benchmark constructed from a subset of MMTEB, comprising 14 existing datasets across Semantic Textual Similarity (STS), classification, retrieval, and reranking. We use this benchmark to evaluate 17 open- and closed-source embedding models under a unified protocol. Our results show that Portuguese performance is strongly task-dependent: multilingual rankings do not reliably predict Portuguese-specific performance across task families, no single model dominates all settings, and models with stronger long-context capacity are particularly advantageous on longer-input tasks such as retrieval and reranking. The benchmark also shows that language-specific fine-tuning still improves model performance in Portuguese, especially on task types that match the adaptation data most closely. To examine this effect, we fine-tune three representative backbone models with Portuguese contrastive supervision and Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). These benchmark-informed baselines yield their strongest gains on STS, consistent with the predominantly symmetric supervision used during training, while also improving retrieval and remaining competitive under dimensional truncation. We release the MTEB-PT benchmark, the fine-tuned models, and the training and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MTEB-PT，一个葡萄牙语文本嵌入评估基准，包含14个数据集和17个模型评估。结果显示：模型性能高度依赖任务类型，多语言排名不能可靠预测葡萄牙语表现，语言特定微调仍能提升性能，尤其是与训练数据匹配的任务。
AI.motivation: 葡萄牙语作为全球广泛使用的语言，在文本嵌入评估中严重缺乏代表性，导致嵌入模型通常基于英语或多语言指标选择，其在葡萄牙语上的实际效果不明。
AI.method: 从MMTEB中构建包含14个数据集的MTEB-PT基准，涵盖STS、分类、检索和重排序任务；在统一协议下评估17个开源和闭源嵌入模型；并对三个代表性骨干模型进行葡萄牙语对比监督和Matryoshka表示学习微调。
AI.result: 葡萄牙语性能高度任务依赖；多语言排名不能可靠预测葡萄牙语表现；没有单一模型在所有设置中占优；长上下文模型在长输入任务上更优；语言特定微调能提升性能，尤其在STS任务上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 需要专门针对葡萄牙语的评估基准来指导模型选择，语言特定的对比微调仍然有效，MTEB-PT为葡萄牙语嵌入研究提供了标准化评估平台。

title: Shortcut Learning in Legal Judgment Prediction: Empirical Evidence from the UK Employment Tribunal
summary: Current Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) is constrained by its reliance on post-hoc judicial materials, increasing the likelihood that models perform retrospective classification rather than true forecasting. This paper empirically investigates shortcut learning in this context by studying claim-level outcome prediction in UK Employment Tribunal (UKET) decisions. Using a corpus of 33,158 individual claims, we predict outcomes from claim texts and LLM-extracted case summaries, evaluating models ranging from interpretable TF-IDF-based classifiers to black-box LLMs. While headline predictive performance figures appear strong, we demonstrate that such performance in LJP systems trained on post-hoc judicial text can be driven by the retrospective nature of the source material. Stratifying the test data by human judgments of leakage reveals that performance increases where outcome-revealing cues are embedded in the narrative. Moreover, a model trained on just the 4% of features identified as leakage achieves high performance, outperforming human experts. These findings substantiate concerns that LJP performance may be exaggerated by linguistic artefacts. Yet this vulnerability is not fatal to the research agenda. Instead, post-hoc judgments might be treated as potentially contaminated texts, requiring active auditing. Retraining models after masking leakage features results in only a negligible reduction in Macro-F1. Hence, while models will opportunistically exploit shortcuts when available, they remain capable of extracting useful predictive signals when these artefacts are removed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了法律判决预测（LJP）中存在的捷径学习问题，发现模型在基于事后司法材料训练时会利用文本中的“泄漏”线索（如结果暗示性表述）获得虚高的预测性能。但通过主动屏蔽这些泄漏特征后，模型仍能保持有效预测能力。
AI.motivation: 当前LJP研究依赖事后司法材料（如已判决案例文本），这可能导致模型进行的是回顾性分类（retrospective classification）而非真正的预测（forecasting）。本文旨在实证检验这种捷径学习现象的存在及其严重程度。
AI.method: 使用33,158份英国就业法庭（UKET）个体索赔案例，比较基于索赔文本和LLM提取的案例摘要的预测效果。评估了从可解释的TF-IDF分类器到黑盒LLM的多种模型，并通过人工判断对测试数据进行泄漏分层分析。
AI.result: 1）模型性能在包含结果暗示线索的示例上显著更高；2）仅使用4%的泄漏特征训练的模型即可超越人类专家；3）屏蔽泄漏特征后重新训练，Macro-F1仅出现可忽略的下降。
AI.conclusion: LJP性能可能因语言伪影（linguistic artefacts）而被夸大，但这一问题并非致命。应将事后判决视为潜在污染文本，通过主动审计和屏蔽泄漏特征，模型仍能从非泄漏信号中提取有效的预测信息。

title: Diagnosing Aerial-View Object Detectors with Foundational Image Generative Models
summary: Recent advances in large-scale image generative models enable photorealistic scene synthesis with controllable attributes. Beyond data augmentation, their potential as diagnostic tools for trained vision systems remains unexplored in the aerial and remote sensing domains. We introduce a synthetic diagnostic framework for aerial-view vehicle detection that combines text-guided generation, attribute-controlled editing, and automated attribute verification to construct a controllable synthetic testbed. This enables fine-grained evaluation of pretrained detectors under diverse scene types and environmental conditions that are difficult to isolate in real datasets. Across three detection architectures and three real aerial datasets, synthetic scene-wise performance trends closely match real-world weaknesses. Guided by these diagnostics, targeted supplementation with small real datasets from the identified weak categories yields improvements of up to 13% AP50 while requiring substantially fewer additional samples than non-targeted augmentation. Our results show that controlled synthetic probing can predict real-domain performance gaps and guide efficient data collection. The proposed diagnostic framework is modular and can incorporate alternative generative or vision-language models as capabilities evolve. Our code and datasets are available here: https://humansensinglab.github.io/AVODDiag/

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可控合成图像的航空视角车辆检测诊断框架，通过文本引导生成和属性编辑构建测试集，揭示检测器在真实场景中的弱点，并有针对性地补充少量数据即可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模图像生成模型在视觉诊断中的应用潜力在遥感领域尚未被探索，现有真实数据集难以隔离特定场景因素进行细粒度评估。
AI.method: 结合文本引导的图像生成、属性可控编辑与自动属性验证，构建可控合成测试环境，对预训练检测器在不同场景和环境条件下进行评估。
AI.result: 合成场景性能趋势与真实数据集表现高度吻合；针对性补充少量弱类别真实数据即可提升最高13% AP50，效率远高于非定向数据增强。
AI.conclusion: 可控合成探测能够预测真实域性能差距并指导高效数据采集，框架具有模块化可扩展性。

title: Semantic Integration and Lexical Expectation Shape N400 and P600 Dynamics During Naturalistic Reading
summary: Word surprisal is a well-established computational predictor of human neural responses during language comprehension, but it remains less clear whether local semantic fit explains neural response variation beyond lexical expectation during naturalistic reading. Using the Dublin EEG-based Reading Experiment Corpus (DERCo), this study examined whether contextual semantic relevance predicts word-locked EEG activity in the N400 and P600 windows. Contextual semantic relevance was computed as an attention-aware measure of how strongly a target word is semantically connected to its recent discourse context, and it was compared with GPT-based word surprisal. Across 22 participants and 32 EEG channels, we tested both predictors using regression-based ERP analyses and generalized additive mixed models while controlling for lexical variables and repeated observations. Both predictors were reliably associated with EEG responses, but they showed partly different temporal and scalp-level patterns. Surprisal captured expectancy-related variation, whereas contextual semantic relevance showed robust effects across N400- and P600-window mean voltages, with particularly strong explanatory support in the P600 window. Model comparisons indicated that contextual semantic relevance contributed explanatory value beyond lexical controls and surprisal. These findings suggest that naturalistic reading depends on both lexical expectation and local semantic integration, and that contextual semantic relevance offers an interpretable computational link between discourse semantic fit and ERP dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用DERCo眼动阅读语料库，发现上下文语义相关性（一种基于注意力的语义匹配度量）能比GPT词意外度更好地解释N400和P600窗口的EEG响应，表明自然阅读同时依赖词汇预期和局部语义整合。
AI.motivation: 词汇意外度虽能预测语言理解的神经响应，但局部语义匹配（上下文语义相关性）是否能在词汇预期之外独立解释自然阅读中的EEG变异尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用DERCo语料库的22名参与者、32通道EEG数据，计算上下文语义相关性（注意力感知的语义连接度量）和GPT词意外度，通过回归分析和广义加性混合模型（GAMM）控制词汇变量和重复观测进行对比。
AI.result: 两个预测因子均可靠关联EEG响应，但时空模式不同：意外度捕获预期相关变异，而上下文语义相关性在N400和P600窗口均有稳健效应，尤其P600窗口解释力更强。模型比较显示其超出词汇控制和意外度的额外解释价值。
AI.conclusion: 自然阅读同时依赖词汇预期和局部语义整合，上下文语义相关性为话语语义匹配与ERP动态之间提供了可解释的计算桥梁。

title: Agentic SABRE: An Uncertainty-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Ransomware Detection
summary: Ransomware has evolved into a complex, adaptive, and fast-moving adversary category in which static signatures and monolithic classifiers fail to generalise under concept drift, evasion, and behavioural polymorphism. In this paper, we present Agentic SABRE (Semantic-Behavioural Arbitration for Ransomware Evaluation), an uncertainty-aware, neuro-symbolic, multi-agent framework for adaptive ransomware detection. SABRE fuses semantic, representation-based evidence with behavioural, time-window forensic telemetry and employs Monte Carlo Dropout inference to quantify epistemic uncertainty for each agent. We introduce a decision-layer orchestrator that performs risk- and uncertainty-aware triage using two interpretable thresholds: a risk score and an uncertainty budget. High-confidence, high-risk samples are automatically contained, while uncertain or borderline cases are escalated to human analysts, establishing a flexible computational contract between autonomous response and analyst oversight. To support auditability and trust, SABRE integrates post-hoc explainability mechanisms, including gradient saliency, permutation importance, and counterfactual analysis, enabling both local and global interpretation of agent decisions. Extensive evaluation on RDset and RanSMAP demonstrates that Agentic SABRE preserves perfect discrimination on saturated semantic datasets, with AUC equal to 1.0, while improving robustness under weak behavioural signals. It achieves up to a 4.9 percent relative reduction in false escalations at equal recall while maintaining calibrated predictive uncertainty. Counterfactual analysis further shows that semantic and behavioural decisions can be reversed with bounded perturbation cost, indicating stable and interpretable decision boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic SABRE，一个不确定性感知的神经符号多智能体框架，通过融合语义和行为证据、MC Dropout量化不确定性、风险-不确定性阈值决策层以及可解释性机制，实现自适应勒索软件检测，在基准数据集上达到AUC=1.0并降低4.9%的误报。
AI.motivation: 勒索软件已演变为复杂、自适应且快速移动的对抗类别，静态签名和单体分类器在概念漂移、规避和行为多态性下难以泛化，需要更鲁棒的自适应检测方法。
AI.method: 融合基于语义的表示证据和基于行为的时窗取证遥测；采用Monte Carlo Dropout推断量化每个智能体的认知不确定性；引入决策层编排器，使用风险评分和不确定性预算两个可解释阈值进行三分类；集成梯度显著性、排列重要性和反事实分析等事后可解释性机制。
AI.result: 在饱和语义数据集上AUC=1.0，保持完美判别力；在弱行为信号下提升了鲁棒性；在等召回率下误报相对减少4.9%；反事实分析表明决策边界稳定且可解释，扰动代价有界。
AI.conclusion: Agentic SABRE通过不确定性感知的神经符号多智能体框架实现了自适应勒索软件检测，在自动化响应与分析师监督之间建立了灵活的计算契约，兼顾了检测性能、鲁棒性和可审计性。

title: Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Grounding-Aware Sensitivity by Perturbation (GASP)
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reduces but does not eliminate hallucination, and existing detectors return a single answer-level score that does not indicate which sentence is unsupported, or why. To close this gap, we introduce Grounding-Aware Sensitivity by Perturbation (GASP), a span-level detector that scores each answer sentence by how strongly its likelihood depends on the retrieved evidence, a quantity we term grounding sensitivity. GASP holds the answer fixed and re-scores it under the full context, under no context, and with each chunk removed, then measures the log-likelihood drops and Jensen-Shannon divergences (JSD). The likelihood of a grounded sentence collapses once its supporting passage is removed, whereas a hallucinated sentence is almost unaffected, a contrast we interpret by casting decoding as a random nonlinear iterated function system (RNIFS). We evaluate GASP on three benchmarks (RAGTruth, TofuEval, RAGBench) with three instruction-tuned scorers from two model families (Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and SmolLM2-1.7B) under a leakage-clean protocol. On RAGTruth it reaches a response-level area under the ROC curve (AUC) of about 0.73 and a span-level AUC of about 0.67, improving significantly over perplexity and by clear margins over length, whole-context natural language inference (NLI), and self-consistency baselines. The only baseline competitive at the span level is a well-configured chunk-level entailment verifier, which requires a separate model, whereas a training-free threshold on the grounding features matches the trained classifier without labeled data and serves as the default detector. Beyond RAGTruth, the signal transfers to TofuEval but not to short-answer question answering in RAGBench, showing GASP is best suited to outputs constructed from the retrieved context rather than answers recoverable from parametric knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GASP，一种基于扰动感知的跨度级幻觉检测方法，通过评估答案句子对检索证据的依赖程度（即“接地敏感性”）来识别无支撑句子。在多个基准上，GASP优于困惑度、NLI等基线，且无需额外训练数据即可匹配有监督分类器。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG幻觉检测方法仅返回整个答案的单一分数，无法定位具体哪个句子缺乏证据支持及其原因。GASP旨在填补这一空白，实现句子级别的细粒度检测。
AI.method: GASP将答案句子分别在完整上下文、无上下文和逐块移除检索证据的条件下重新评分，计算对数似然下降量和JS散度。通过观察有支撑句子在移除其支持段落时似然度骤降、而幻觉句子几乎不受影响这一对比特征进行检测。该方法将解码过程解释为随机非线性迭代函数系统（RNIFS）。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth上，响应级AUC约0.73，跨度级AUC约0.67，显著优于困惑度、长度、全上下文NLI和自一致性基线。仅与配置良好的分块级蕴含验证器（需额外模型）竞争。无训练阈值即可匹配有监督分类器。信号可迁移至TofuEval，但不适用于RAGBench的短答案QA任务。
AI.conclusion: GASP最适合于从检索上下文构建的生成输出，而非可从参数化知识中恢复的答案。其无训练阈值特性使其成为实用的默认检测器。

title: HAS-Bench: Evaluating LLM-Based Human-Agent Systems under Configurable Human Participation
summary: Large language models increasingly operate in settings where humans are active collaborators rather than passive task providers. We introduce HAS-Framework, a graph-based framework that represents humans and LLM-powered agents as first-class participants with explicit roles, permissions, communication paths, and action authority. Building on this framework, HAS-Bench evaluates Human-Agent Systems under configurable human participation across agency levels, interaction channels, and persona policies. The benchmark measures both task outcomes and process-level collaboration behavior, including clarification quality, feedback utilization, control calibration, safety, initiative, and interaction cost. Experiments across six domains show that human participation can substantially improve task completion and failure recovery, but the gains depend on when, how, and by whom human input is exercised.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAS-Framework框架和HAS-Bench基准，用于评估人类与LLM智能体在不同参与程度下的协作效果，发现人类参与能提升任务完成和故障恢复，但收益取决于参与的时机、方式和人员。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将人类视为被动任务提供者，忽略了人机协作中人类的主动角色；需要系统化的框架来建模和评估不同人类参与模式对LLM系统的影响。
AI.method: 提出基于图的HAS-Framework框架，将人类和LLM智能体视为一等参与者，定义角色、权限、通信路径和行动权限；在此基础上构建HAS-Bench基准，在多个维度（代理级别、交互渠道、人格策略）上配置人类参与，测量任务结果和过程级协作行为（澄清质量、反馈利用、控制校准、安全、主动性、交互成本）。
AI.result: 在六个领域的实验表明，人类参与可以显著提升任务完成率和故障恢复能力，但收益依赖于人类输入被行使的时机、方式和具体参与者。
AI.conclusion: 人类与LLM智能体的有效协作需要精心设计参与机制，简单的"加入人类"并不能保证性能提升，需要关注参与的具体维度和条件。

title: Provable Pruning for Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting via Coresets
comment: 39 pages, 15 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/waseem-m/3dgs_provable_coresets
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but practical scenes often contain millions of Gaussians, making compression essential for deployment on limited hardware. Existing reduction methods are effective but mostly heuristic: they provide no multiplicative approximation guarantee for the rendered objective, and thus rely heavily on costly post-pruning finetuning to recover quality. We ask a basic question: can a 3DGS scene be provably replaced by a much smaller weighted subset (coreset) while preserving the objective of interest? We first show that, in the unrestricted setting, no non-trivial multiplicative 3DGS coreset exists. We then show that multiplicative guarantees are not impossible, but resolution-dependent. For a prescribed rendering resolution, such as representative views or grids of views/rays, we provide the first weighted coreset construction theorem for 3DGS. The construction samples Gaussians by sensitivity: provable importance scores measuring each Gaussian's role in the full-scene objective. Finally, under explicit validity and log-transmittance stability assumptions, we turn this objective guarantee into a rendering guarantee. Empirically, our method is strongest where deployment needs it most: aggressive compression with no or minimal recovery compute. In prune-only and very short finetuning regimes, it achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing that principled importance estimation can be both theoretically meaningful and practically useful. Open-source code is available at https://github.com/waseem-m/3dgs_provable_coresets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于敏感度采样的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）可证明核心集压缩方法，能在无微调或极短微调下实现高质量渲染，并首次提供乘法近似保证。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS压缩方法缺乏理论保证，依赖昂贵的后剪枝微调来恢复质量。作者希望探索是否存在一个可证明的小加权子集（核心集）来替代原始3DGS场景，并保留渲染目标。
AI.method: 首先证明无限制条件下不存在非平凡乘法3DGS核心集；然后证明在指定分辨率下（如视图/射线网格）存在加权核心集，通过敏感度（重要性分数）采样高斯；最后在有效性和对数透射率稳定性假设下将目标保证转化为渲染保证。
AI.result: 在仅剪枝和极短微调场景下，该方法达到最先进性能，证明原理性重要性估计既有理论意义又有实际价值。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在需要激进压缩且计算资源有限的部署场景中最具优势，为首个具有乘法近似保证的3DGS压缩方案。

title: Spinning Straw into Gold: Relabeling LLM Agent Trajectories in Hindsight for Successful Demonstrations
summary: Large language model agents operate in partially observable, long-horizon settings where obtaining supervision remains a major bottleneck. We address this by utilizing a source of supervision overlooked in existing post-training methods: unintended yet successful goals embedded within agent rollouts. Specifically, we introduce Hindsight Supervised Learning (HSL), where an auxiliary LLM reviews each completed trajectory and relabels it with all of the natural-language goals the agent actually achieved. HSL then pairs the trajectory with its relabeled goals and uses these pairs for additional fine-tuning. To mitigate suboptimality in the relabeled data, we propose two learning techniques for HSL, irrelevant-action masking and sample reweighting. Our experiments show that HSL is flexible and compatible with existing post-training pipelines. It improves both SFT and DPO, with larger gains on long-horizon tasks with more diverse goal spaces. Moreover, HSL is sample-efficient: on ALFWorld, it surpasses baselines trained on the full dataset while using only one quarter of the ground-truth demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hindsight Supervised Learning (HSL)方法，通过利用智能体轨迹中无意达成的成功目标，对轨迹进行重新标注并用于微调，从而提升大语言模型智能体在部分可观测、长周期任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在部分可观测、长周期环境中运行时，获取有效监督信号是一个主要瓶颈，现有后训练方法忽略了轨迹中隐含的意外成功目标这一监督来源。
AI.method: 提出HSL方法：1) 用辅助LLM回顾已完成轨迹，用自然语言重新标注智能体实际达成的所有目标；2) 将轨迹与重标目标配对用于微调；3) 引入无关动作掩码和样本重加权两种技术来缓解重标数据中的次优性问题。
AI.result: HSL灵活兼容SFT和DPO等现有训练流程，在长周期、多样目标空间的任务上提升更大；在ALFWorld上仅使用1/4的真实演示数据即可超越基线模型在全量数据上的表现。
AI.conclusion: HSL是一种样本高效、即插即用的方法，能够有效利用轨迹中隐含的成功信号，显著提升LLM智能体在复杂环境中的学习效率。

title: Do GUI Agents Believe Their Eyes? Diagnosing State-Belief Reliance on Pixels versus Structure
summary: Multimodal GUI agents read an interface through two redundant channels: the rendered pixels of a screenshot and a serialized structure such as a DOM or accessibility tree. Before acting, an agent forms a belief about the current interface state, but existing benchmarks score task success, element grounding, or attack resistance and do not ask whether that belief is drawn from the pixels. We formalize visual state reliance, the attribution of a state belief to pixels, structure, or priors, and measure it with paired single-channel interventions over 310 real web, mobile, and desktop probes. Every probe is scored by deterministic forced choice, with no model-generated item and no model judge. Our central metric is the Perception-Fusion Gap, the fraction of probes a model perceives correctly yet resolves toward structure under conflict. Across five models from three vendors, textual state beliefs defer to structure while image-only accuracy stays near ceiling, and Perception-Fusion Gap is positive for every model; non-text identity, by contrast, stays largely pixel-bound. The substitution is specific to the serialized-text and indexed-action channel, and coordinate-action agents are largely immune. For textual conflicts, a white-box ablation traces the effect to a single copied structural value, and in two live environments the conflict drives wrong actions and real task failure. Visual state reliance therefore gives a measurable diagnostic of whether agent state beliefs are visually grounded, and the errors it exposes propagate to actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出感知-融合差距（Perception-Fusion Gap）指标，通过单通道干预实验测量多模态GUI代理的视觉状态依赖程度，发现文本代理会优先依赖结构化表示而非像素信息，导致信念偏差和实际任务失败。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只评估任务成功率、元素定位或抗攻击能力，不关注代理的状态信念是否真正来自视觉像素，缺乏对视觉状态依赖的量化诊断方法。
AI.method: 形式化定义视觉状态依赖，设计配对单通道干预实验（310个真实网页、移动端和桌面端探针），使用确定性强制选择评分（无模型生成项、无模型裁判），提出感知-融合差距（Perception-Fusion Gap）作为核心指标。
AI.result: 五个模型均呈现正感知-融合差距；文本状态信念偏向结构，纯图像准确率接近上限；非文本身份代理主要依赖像素；冲突效应可追溯到单个复制的结构值，并在真实环境中导致错误动作和任务失败。
AI.conclusion: 视觉状态依赖是可测量的诊断指标，能反映代理状态信念是否基于视觉，且该偏差会传递到实际动作中，导致真实任务失败。

title: Risk-Constrained Freshness-Aware Semantic Caching for Open-Web Retrieval-Augmented LLMs
summary: Semantic caching reduces the latency and cost of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) by serving cached answers to semantically similar queries, but most existing methods do not model the time-varying freshness of open-web evidence. We present FreshCache, a three-tier semantic cache that treats cache reuse as a risk-constrained temporal inference problem: before approving a cache hit, FreshCache estimates the probability that the cached result is stale using a fitted exponential decay model enhanced by a learned MLP, and approves reuse only when that probability falls below a per-tier error budget across answers (epsilon = 0.10), URL lists (epsilon = 0.20), and page content (epsilon = 0.35). This allows the system to degrade gracefully as entries age rather than forcing a binary choice between a stale hit and a full pipeline execution. We introduce FreshCache-Bench, a benchmark of 8,072 base queries across five freshness classes with ground truth staleness labels drawn from real web snapshots at 1, 12, 24 hours, and 7 days after a baseline crawl, expanded to 31,201 queries via paraphrase generation. At the 24-hour evaluation window, FreshCache_MLP achieves 97% search API savings at 0.1% hash-based stale error, and an LLM-judge evaluation on 396 confirmed change pairs shows that only 34.3% of detected content changes actually affect answer correctness, placing true answer-affecting stale error at approximately 0.034%. The rule-based FreshCache achieves 98% search savings at 3.3% stale error under a temporal holdout calibration, outperforming SemanticTTL (14.9% stale, 72% saved), vCache (7.2% stale, 47% saved), and SCALM (5.2% stale, 96% saved). Ablations show the temporal risk gate accounts for an 11.6 point reduction in stale error over similarity-only reuse, and the learned MLP reduces stale error a further 3.2 points over the rule-based model.

AI.tldr: FreshCache是一种三层语义缓存系统，通过将缓存复用建模为风险约束的时间推断问题，在缓存命中前评估内容过时概率，在保持极低过时错误率的同时大幅节省搜索API调用。在24小时评估窗口下，FreshCache_MLP在0.1%哈希过时错误率下实现97%的搜索API节省，规则版FreshCache在3.3%过时错误率下实现98%搜索节省，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG语义缓存方法未建模开放网络证据随时间变化的时效性，导致缓存结果可能过时（stale），系统被迫在过时命中与完整流水线执行之间做二元选择。
AI.method: 提出三层语义缓存架构（答案/URL列表/页面内容），各层设不同错误预算；采用拟合指数衰减模型结合学习型MLP估计缓存过时概率，仅在概率低于层预算阈值时批准缓存复用。
AI.result: FreshCache_MLP在24小时窗口以0.1%哈希过时错误率实现97%搜索API节省；规则版FreshCache以3.3%过时错误率实现98%搜索节省，显著优于SemanticTTL（14.9%过时,72%节省）、vCache（7.2%过时,47%节省）和SCALM（5.2%过时,96%节省）。约34.3%的内容变化实际影响答案正确性，真实答案影响过时错误率约0.034%。
AI.conclusion: 时间风险门控机制相比仅基于相似度的复用降低11.6个百分点的过时错误率，学习型MLP进一步降低3.2个百分点，验证了建模时间衰减对语义缓存质量的重要性。

title: CausalGame: Benchmarking Causal Thinking of LLM Agents in Games
comment: Zhenhao, Yongqiang, and Chenxi contributed equally to the project. A short version is accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026 as an Oral presentation. Project website https://causalgame.github.io/
summary: Building AI Scientist agents with Large Language Models (LLMs) has recently attracted growing attention. Since scientific discovery fundamentally relies on uncovering causal relationships from observations, the capability of causal thinking, i.e., distinguishing causation from correlation and recognizing hidden biases, is essential to LLM agents. Although a number of benchmarks exist for AI Scientists, none explicitly incorporate challenges from selection bias, measurement error, and hidden confounders that widely exist in real-world scientific discovery. To this end, we present CausalGame, a benchmark that evaluates the causal thinking capabilities of LLM agents through interactive games. CausalGame asks LLM agents to actively design experimental protocols, collect observation data, and derive a final solution with an explanation report. To emulate realistic scientific discovery challenges, we design 14 scenarios that incorporate selection bias, measurement error, and hidden confounders. Across 30 LLM agents, none demonstrates reliable causal thinking: the best model reaches only 68.0% survival against analytical optima of 78-85%, and merely 5-7% of sessions receive credits on the causal-reasoning rubrics. CausalGame provides a scalable and controlled testbed for evaluating the causal thinking of AI Scientist agents.

AI.tldr: CausalGame是一个评估LLM智能体因果思维能力的交互式游戏基准，包含14个融合选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混淆变量的科学发现场景。测试30个LLM智能体，最佳模型存活率仅68.0%（最优为78-85%），因果推理评分仅5-7%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科学家基准未明确纳入真实科学发现中普遍存在的选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混淆变量等因果推理挑战，缺乏专门评估LLM智能体因果思维能力的测试平台。
AI.method: 设计了14个包含选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混淆变量三大因果挑战的交互式游戏场景，要求LLM智能体主动设计实验方案、收集观测数据并输出最终解决方案与解释报告。
AI.result: 30个LLM智能体均未表现出可靠的因果思维能力：最佳模型存活率仅68.0%（分析最优为78-85%），仅5-7%的会话在因果推理评分中获得分数。
AI.conclusion: CausalGame为评估AI科学家的因果思维能力提供了一个可扩展、可控的测试平台，揭示了当前LLM在因果推理方面的严重不足。

title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs
summary: We present Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B, a compressed variant of Nemotron-3-Super optimized for interactive deployment. We designed the model to maximize server throughput under high user throughput constraints. In interactive serving workloads on a single 8xB200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B achieves approximately 2x higher server throughput than Nemotron-3-Super at matched user throughput constraints. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model increases 1M-token concurrency from 1 request to 8 requests. Puzzle-75B-A9B is constructed using a multi-stage pipeline that combines the Iterative Puzzle compression framework with knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, quantization, and a Multi-Token Prediction head. The compression process jointly optimizes heterogeneous MoE pruning, active parameter budget, and Mamba pruning to improve inference efficiency while preserving model quality. We evaluate Puzzle-75B-A9B on a broad suite of reasoning, coding, multilingual, long-context, and agentic benchmarks. Despite substantial compression, the model retains strong downstream accuracy relative to the parent model across a wide range of tasks. These results demonstrate that large hybrid MoE models can be substantially optimized for deployment efficiency while maintaining strong downstream capability.

AI.tldr: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B 是通过多阶段压缩流程从 Nemotron-3-Super 压缩而来的混合MoE模型，在保持较强下游能力的同时，实现了约2倍服务吞吐量提升和长上下文并发能力的大幅增长。
AI.motivation: 针对 Nemotron-3-Super 等大模型在交互式部署场景下吞吐量不足、高用户并发下性能受限的问题，提出一种压缩方案以最大化服务器吞吐量，同时保持模型质量。
