Inspired by VFX industry practices, we insert a synthetic chrome ball into the scene to compel the model to generate physically plausible reflections from the surrounding spatio-temporal context. To bridge the gap from LDR-native models to the HDR domain, we design an HDR-aware VAE and employ an efficient LoRA-based fine-tuning strategy. We then construct a mixed dataset comprising high-fidelity HDR images to provide realistic HDR priors, and in-the-wild HDR videos to provide dynamic spatio-temporal context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that V-LITE produces temporally coherent HDR environment maps, revealing that modern video diffusion models are not merely synthesizers but also powerful, inherently capable estimators of physical scene lighting.

AI.tldr: V-LITE利用视频生成模型的内在光照理解能力，通过引导式视频修补任务实现从单段野外视频中恢复动态HDR环境贴图，生成时间连贯的逼真光照效果。
AI.motivation: 从单段野外视频中恢复动态环境贴图对于逼真渲染至关重要，但现有方法仍面临挑战，而视频生成模型本身具备复杂光照的固有理解能力，因此希望挖掘这一内隐知识。
AI.method: 将光照估计重构为引导式视频修补任务，插入合成铬球体迫使模型生成物理合理的反射；设计HDR感知VAE并采用LoRA微调策略，同时构建包含高保真HDR图像和野外HDR视频的混合数据集。
AI.result: V-LITE能生成时间连贯的HDR环境贴图，实验证明现代视频扩散模型不仅是合成器，更是物理场景光照的强大内在估计器。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成模型具备内在光照估计能力，V-LITE框架有效解锁了该能力，实现了从单视频到动态HDR环境贴图的跨越。

title: ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Cross-Scenario Defect Detection and Fine-Grained Severity Grading for High-Precision Manufacturing
summary: This paper presents the IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME) 2026 Grand Challenge on Cross-Scenario Defect Detection and Fine-Grained Severity Grading for High-Precision Manufacturing. The challenge is motivated by two key limitations of existing industrial defect inspection systems: (1) current deep learning-based methods often suffer significant performance degradation when deployed in unseen production scenarios, and (2) most benchmarks neglect severity-aware assessment, which is critical for risk control and yield optimization. To address these limitations, we design two complementary tracks: Track 1 (Cross-Scenario Defect Detection) targets accurate defect detection, localization, and classification across diverse unseen production environments; Track 2 (Fine-Grained Severity Grading) requires assigning each detected defect an industry-standard severity level, including Acceptable, Marginal NG, NG, and Gross NG. We construct a large-scale industrial dataset of high-resolution microscopic images spanning seven representative defect categories, comprising over 3,800 images with pixel-level instance annotations for Track 1 and over 2,600 images with severity-grade labels for Track 2. The challenge attracted 86 registered participants with 130 submissions; during the final testing phase, 21 teams submitted results and 12 teams provided models with technical reports. The resulting benchmark, together with the diverse and effective solutions contributed by participating teams, sets a new standard for industrial defect analysis research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ICME 2026关于跨场景缺陷检测与细粒度严重性分级的Grand Challenge，针对现有工业缺陷检测系统在未见场景下性能下降以及缺乏严重性评估两大问题，设计双赛道竞赛，构建了大规模高分辨率工业显微图像数据集，吸引了大量参赛团队，为工业缺陷分析研究建立了新基准。
AI.motivation: 现有工业缺陷检测系统存在两个关键局限：(1)深度学习模型在未见过的生产场景中性能严重下降；(2)大多数基准忽略了严重性评估，而这对于风险控制和良率优化至关重要。
AI.method: 设计两个互补赛道：Track 1（跨场景缺陷检测）专注于在不同未见生产环境中准确检测、定位和分类缺陷；Track 2（细粒度严重性分级）要求为每个检测到的缺陷分配行业标准严重性等级。构建了包含7类缺陷、超过3800张图像（像素级标注）和2600张图像（严重性标注）的大规模数据集。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了86名注册参与者，130份提交；最终测试阶段21支队伍提交结果，12支队伍提供了模型和技术报告。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛建立的基准以及参赛团队贡献的多样化有效解决方案，为工业缺陷分析研究树立了新标准。

title: AnyStyle: A Single LoRA is Sufficient for Image-Guided Style Transfer
summary: Image-guided style transfer aims to apply the artistic characteristics of a style image to a content image while preserving its semantic structure and layout. Despite advances in diffusion-based methods, existing approaches often face challenges in disentangling content and style, particularly when independently optimized adapters are naively combined, causing conflicts between adapters and limiting controllability over the content-style balance in inference. We further demonstrate that training-free structural guidance directly derived from the content image through the internal attention of pre-trained model outperforms a dedicated content LoRA adapter in terms of structural fidelity and computational efficiency. Building on these observations, we propose AnyStyle, a streamlined framework for image-guided style transfer. The framework adopts a unified single-adapter paradigm for coherent style capture from the style image and incorporates training-free structural guidance from the content image, thus avoiding complex entanglement between multiple adapters and improving controllability and stability. Extensive experiments show that our method delivers competitive quantitative performance and significantly improved perceptual quality. Code is available at https://github.com/Yvan1001/AnyStyle.

AI.tldr: AnyStyle提出了一种统一的单适配器框架，结合训练自由的结构引导，用于图像引导的风格迁移，有效避免了多适配器冲突，提升了可控性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的风格迁移方法在解耦内容与风格时存在困难，特别是独立优化的适配器组合会导致适配器冲突，且在推理阶段对内容-风格平衡的控制能力有限。
AI.method: 采用统一的单适配器范式从风格图像中捕捉风格特征，同时从内容图像内部注意力中提取训练自由的结构引导信息，避免了多适配器之间的复杂纠缠。
AI.result: 在定量性能上具有竞争力，在感知质量上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AnyStyle通过简化框架解决了多适配器冲突问题，在保持内容结构的同时实现了有效的风格迁移，代码已开源。

title: TubeLite: Lightweight Multi-Actor Spatio-Temporal Action Detection
summary: Spatio-temporal action detection in videos requires jointly localizing actors in space and identifying action boundaries over time. A common challenge is constructing temporally stable action tubes, as frame-level detectors often suffer from jitter, fragmentation, and imprecise temporal localization. Many recent approaches address this by introducing heavy spatio-temporal transformers or optical-flow-based pipelines, leading to high computational cost and limited scalability. We propose TubeLite, a lightweight framework for spatio-temporal action detection that focuses on stable tube construction and boundary-aware temporal modeling. TubeLite represents each actor as a tube, defined as a sequence of bounding boxes associated with a single actor over time, and explicitly enforces temporal consistency at both the spatial and semantic levels. The method combines low-jitter actor detection, Gaussian-weighted actor feature extraction, efficient short-term temporal propagation, and a boundary-focused temporal prediction head, while avoiding optical flow and large-scale temporal attention. Despite its compact design, TubeLite achieves strong video-level localization performance. It improves Video-mAP@0.5 by 4.5 and 7.1 percentage points over the best compared method on the MultiSports and UCF101-24 datasets, respectively, with substantially fewer parameters and floating-point operations than transformer-based alternatives, demonstrating that effective spatio-temporal action detection can be obtained through principled, lightweight temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: TubeLite提出了一种轻量级的时空动作检测框架，通过稳定动作管构建和边界感知时间建模，在不使用光流和大规模时间注意力的情况下，在MultiSports和UCF101-24数据集上分别提升了4.5和7.1个百分点的Video-mAP@0.5，且参数量和计算量远低于基于Transformer的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时空动作检测方法存在时间不稳定（如抖动、片段化）、时间定位不精确等问题，而引入大型时空Transformer或光流方法则导致计算成本高、可扩展性差。作者希望在不增加复杂度的前提下实现稳定且高效的时空动作检测。
AI.method: TubeLite将每个演员表示为时间上的边界框序列（即动作管），通过低抖动演员检测、高斯加权特征提取、高效的短期时间传播以及边界聚焦的时间预测头来显式增强时空一致性，避免使用光流和大规模时间注意力机制。
AI.result: 在MultiSports数据集上Video-mAP@0.5提升4.5个百分点，在UCF101-24数据集上提升7.1个百分点，且参数量和浮点运算数显著低于Transformer方法。
AI.conclusion: 有效的时空动作检测可以通过原则性的轻量级时间建模来实现，而不必依赖复杂的Transformer或光流网络。

title: From Open Loop to Closed Loop: A Test-Time Iterative Optimization Framework for Reference-Consistent Image Generation
summary: While controllable image generation has made significant strides by incorporating visual reference conditions, existing methods predominantly operate as open-loop systems. They inject control signals in a strictly feed-forward manner, failing to guarantee strict fidelity to the reference due to the absence of active feedback and error correction mechanisms. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel test-time iterative optimization framework that reformulates reference-consistent generation as a closed-loop dynamic tracking problem. By treating the pre-trained generative model as a control plant, our framework employs a sensor-controller architecture driven by a modified Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) algorithm. This mechanism iteratively optimizes the latent control signals at test time based on the sensed discrepancy between the generated output and the reference target. Notably, this approach is entirely training-free, model-agnostic, and integrates seamlessly around existing diffusion pipelines. Extensive evaluations across ID-preserving, pose-controlled, and depth-controlled generation tasks validate the universality of our method. Empirical results demonstrate improvements over computation-matched open-loop baselines, achieving relative performance gains of up to 25.36\% for facial similarity, alongside spatial error reductions of up to 27.71\% for pose alignment and 28.50\% for depth consistency. More broadly, this work offers a new conceptual perspective: it demonstrates that controllable generation can be effectively managed as a dynamic feedback system, bringing the rigorous principles of classical control theory into the optimization of generative models. Code is available at https://github.com/zzdrill/From-Open-Loop-to-Closed-Loop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于闭环反馈的测试时迭代优化框架，将可控图像生成视为动态跟踪问题，利用改进的PID算法迭代优化潜在控制信号，无需训练即可显著提升生成结果对参考条件的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有可控图像生成方法多为开环系统，以严格前馈方式注入控制信号，缺乏主动反馈和误差校正机制，无法保证对参考条件的高保真度。
AI.method: 提出测试时迭代优化框架，将预训练生成模型视为控制对象，采用传感器-控制器架构，利用改进的PID算法基于生成输出与参考目标之间的感知差异迭代优化潜在控制信号。该方法无需训练、与模型无关，可无缝集成到现有扩散管线中。
AI.result: 在身份保持、姿态控制和深度控制生成任务上，相比计算匹配的开环基线，面部相似度相对提升25.36%，姿态对齐空间误差降低27.71%，深度一致性误差降低28.50%。
AI.conclusion: 可控生成可以被有效管理为动态反馈系统，将经典控制理论的严谨原则引入生成模型优化中。

title: Probe-EM: Targeted Neuron Tracing via Training-Free Semantic Verification
summary: Establishing large-scale, high-resolution neural connectivity maps is fundamental to elucidating the structural basis of brain function. However, when processing terabyte- or petabyte-scale electron microscopy data, over-segmentation inherent in automated reconstruction algorithms remains a critical bottleneck, requiring extensive manual proofreading spanning person-years. To alleviate the heavy reliance on annotated data and the limited flexibility of conventional tracing methods, we propose a training-free, targeted neuron tracing framework. Specifically, we introduce a skeleton-guided Heuristic Spatial Search paradigm that leverages geometric priors to iteratively reconstruct neuronal morphologies through a probing-verification cycle. To achieve robust zero-shot semantic verification, we further develop a Dimension-Aware Semantic Verification strategy built upon the foundation model NeuroSAM 2. This strategy resolves intra-slice splits via Planar Ensemble Consensus and inter-slice splits via Axial Spatio-Temporal Propagation. Notably, we integrate the proposed workflow into the Neuroglancer visualization platform, enabling an interactive human-in-the-loop proofreading system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms supervised baselines and reduces manual proofreading time by 33.4%. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HeadLiuYun/Probe-EM.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的、基于骨架引导启发式空间搜索和NeuroSAM 2语义验证的靶向神经元追踪框架，能自动修正电子显微镜数据中的过分割问题，减少33.4%人工校对时间。
AI.motivation: 大规模电子显微镜数据重建中，自动算法存在严重的过分割问题，传统方法依赖大量人工标注和有限灵活性的追踪方式，耗时巨大。
AI.method: 提出训练-free的靶向追踪框架：(1) 骨架引导的启发式空间搜索，利用几何先验通过探测-验证循环迭代重建形态；(2) 基于NeuroSAM 2的维度感知语义验证策略，包括平面集成共识和轴向时空传播；(3) 集成到Neuroglancer平台实现人机交互校对。
AI.result: 该方法优于有监督基线，减少了33.4%的人工校对时间。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的零样本、无需训练的追踪框架有效缓解了过分割瓶颈，显著提升了电子显微镜数据重建效率，且开源可用。

title: Learning Probabilistic Prompt for Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning aims to progressively learn from a sequence of tasks, each containing a disjoint subset of classes, while preserving previously learned knowledge. Prompt-based continual learning methods propose to learn a small set of parameters, i.e., prompts, by associating them with a query feature of an input image. These methods optimize the prompts, attempting to represent diverse patterns of images. However, we have observed that existing prompt-based methods suffer from a prompt collapse problem, that is, the prompts tend to be highly similar to each other, thereby failing to capture the diverse data distributions in continual learning scenarios. To address this issue, we propose in this paper a novel prompt-based continual learning framework that captures diverse patterns of images across a sequence of tasks. To this end, we model each prompt as a probabilistic distribution and construct a mixture of these distributions, from which we sample diverse prompts. This enables our model to effectively capture highly diverse image distributions in the continual learning process. We also present a distribution regularization loss to prevent abrupt changes in the prompt distributions throughout the training process. We show extensive experimental results for continual learning on standard benchmarks, including ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100, and CUB-200, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率分布提示的持续学习方法，通过将每个提示建模为概率分布并构建混合分布来采样多样化提示，解决现有方法中的提示崩溃问题，在多个基准上取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的持续学习方法存在提示崩溃问题，即提示之间高度相似，无法捕获持续学习场景中多样化的数据分布。
AI.method: 将每个提示建模为概率分布，构建这些分布的混合模型，从中采样多样化提示；同时提出分布正则化损失，防止训练过程中提示分布发生剧烈变化。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100和CUB-200等标准持续学习基准上进行了大量实验，证明了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于概率分布的提示框架能够有效捕获持续学习过程中高度多样化的图像分布，缓解提示崩溃问题。

title: Reference-Induced Consensus for Selective Posed-Reference Visual Localization
summary: We present RIC-Loc (Reference-Induced Consensus localization), a scene-training-free posed-reference localizer that is SfM-point-map-free in its main estimator: it uses known reference poses, but not precomputed SfM 3D map points, query-to-map 2D-3D matches, or query-to-map PnP. A frozen VGGT pass predicts local camera poses, depth, and query-reference tracks for a query and selected references. Each reference induces one map-frame SE(3) query-pose hypothesis, robust consensus estimates the pose, and the preserved hypothesis structure yields two reliability scores: spatial dispersion and a track-conditioned covariance score. On the covariance-eligible set, the two scores are complementary for held-out, ground-truth-free failure detection across indoor, outdoor, and large-scale low-texture benchmarks: the joint policy is strongest in textured scenes and the covariance score in the low-texture regime, and the hypothesis-derived scores consistently outperform the standard retrieval-score gap and random rankings. Without per-scene training the consensus estimator remains accurate -- competitive with structure-based localization indoors and improving over a comparable feed-forward baseline -- giving an effective selective operating regime for posed-reference localization. Code is available at https://github.com/SNU-DLLAB/ric_loc.

AI.tldr: RIC-Loc是一种无需场景训练、无需SfM点云、无需2D-3D匹配或PnP的定位方法，通过参考姿态、冻结VGGT网络和鲁棒共识机制实现高效定位，并利用假设结构提供两种可靠性评分用于故障检测。
AI.motivation: 现有定位方法依赖SfM点云、2D-3D匹配或场景级训练，计算成本高且泛化性受限。作者希望设计一种无需场景训练、无需SfM点云、无需传统PnP的定位器，同时保持高精度和可可靠性评估能力。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的VGGT网络为查询图像和参考图像预测局部相机姿态、深度和查询-参考轨迹；2) 每个参考诱导一个SE(3)查询姿态假设；3) 通过鲁棒共识估计最终姿态；4) 利用假设结构计算两种可靠性分数：空间离散度和轨迹条件协方差分数，用于无真值故障检测。
AI.result: 在室内、室外和大规模低纹理场景中：1) 联合策略在纹理场景表现最强，协方差分数在低纹理场景最优；2) 假设驱动分数优于标准检索分数差距和随机排序；3) 无需场景训练的共识估计精度与基于结构的方法相当，且优于同类前馈基线。
AI.conclusion: RIC-Loc实现了无需场景训练、无需SfM点云的posed-reference定位范式，在精度和可靠性检测上均表现出色，为高效定位提供了新方案。

title: When Does High-CFG Diffusion Inversion Fail? A Controlled Study of Prompt--Latent Interactions
summary: Text-guided diffusion inversion is central to image editing, where an image is mapped to an initial latent and then edited by replaying the denoising process under a modified prompt. In practice, however, inversion is often performed with a lower classifier-free guidance(CFG) scale than the one used for generation or editing. This mismatch is empirically useful but leaves a basic question unresolved: when a target image is generated by a high-CFG trajectory, when can that trajectory actually be inverted? We study this question in a controlled generation--inversion--reconstruction setting, where the true initial latent and denoising trajectory are known. Using prompts taken from an existing diffusion-editing benchmark, we generate images under high CFG and reconstruct them with fixed-point inversion using the same prompt and guidance setting. The results reveal three types of prompt-level reconstruction behavior: easy prompts that reconstruct for most initial latents, hard prompts that fail for most initial latents, and intermediate prompts whose success depends on the prompt--latent pairing. To analyze the generation side, we define prompt pressure, a step-wise measure of how strongly CFG moves the denoising update away from the unconditional trajectory. Total pressure correlates with reconstruction quality and separates easy from hard prompts, but it does not explain the success or failure of intermediate prompt--latent pairs. Text-side analyses further show that the main visual subject and wording can change inversion difficulty. Finally, we evaluate a compact trajectory-consistency intervention that relaxes guidance only at locally unstable inverse steps. This diagnostic check improves reconstruction and Prompt-to-Prompt editing in our controlled setting, supporting the view that high-CFG inversion failure requires local, trajectory-aware analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高CFG尺度下扩散模型的反转问题，发现重建效果与提示词难度相关，并提出了一种局部轨迹一致性干预方法来改善反转与编辑效果。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中，扩散模型的反转常使用比生成时更低的CFG尺度，这种不匹配虽然有效但缺乏理论解释。作者希望探究当目标图像由高CFG轨迹生成时，该轨迹是否以及何时可以被反转。
AI.method: 在已知真实初始潜变量和去噪轨迹的生成-反转-重建受控设置中，使用现有扩散编辑基准的提示词生成高CFG图像，通过不动点反转重建；定义"提示压力"（prompt pressure）作为逐步骤度量；并设计轨迹一致性干预方法，在局部不稳定反转步骤放松指导。
AI.result: 发现三类提示词重建行为：简单提示（大多数潜变量可重建）、困难提示（大多数失败）和中间提示（依赖潜变量配对）。总压力与重建质量相关，但无法解释中间类型的成败。文本分析显示视觉主体和措辞影响反转难度。所提干预方法在受控设置下改善了重建和Prompt-to-Prompt编辑。
AI.conclusion: 高CFG反转失败需要局部、轨迹感知的分析，所提轨迹一致性干预为诊断和改善反转提供了有效手段。

title: DriftST: One-Step Generative Inference of Spatial Transcriptomics from H\&E Histology
summary: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression while preserving spatial context, but its high cost and low throughput leave public datasets small. Inferring expression directly from widely available Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained histology offers a cost-effective alternative. However, existing approaches face several limitations: regression methods over-smooth toward the conditional mean, while generative methods are faithful but require slow multi-step inference; most methods treat genes as independent and equally important, ignoring inter-gene dependencies and heterogeneous gene informativeness; and most are tailored to a single resolution, either spot-level or cell-level. To address these issues, we propose DriftST, a unified framework for inferring spatially resolved gene expression from H&E images. DriftST builds on a Cellular Drifting generative model that learns a direct drift from a histology-conditioned source to the expression distribution, retaining generative expressiveness while enabling efficient one-step generation. To capture gene structure, we introduce the STransformer, which combines a co-expression attention module for inter-gene dependencies with a gene residual gate for differential gene importance. Operating on a generic gene-panel representation, DriftST applies directly to both spot-level and cell-level data in one framework, and extensive experiments across diverse tissues and platforms show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance at both resolutions.

AI.tldr: DriftST是一个统一框架，通过构建基于细胞漂移的生成模型，从H&E染色图像直接推断具有空间分辨率的基因表达，在保留生成模型表达能力的同时实现单步高效推理，并在点级和细胞级两种分辨率上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学（ST）成本高、通量低，公共数据集规模有限。从广泛可用的H&E染色组织学图像推断基因表达是一种低成本替代方案，但现有方法存在过平滑、推理速度慢、忽略基因间依赖关系及基因重要性差异、仅支持单一分辨率等问题。
AI.method: 提出DriftST框架，核心包括：（1）细胞漂移生成模型，学习从组织学条件源到表达分布的直接漂移，实现单步高效生成；（2）STransformer模块，包含共表达注意力机制捕获基因间依赖关系，以及基因残差门控处理不同基因的重要性差异；（3）基于通用基因面板表示，统一支持点级和细胞级两种分辨率。
AI.result: 在多种组织和平台上进行大量实验，DriftST在点级和细胞级两种分辨率上都达到了当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: DriftST有效解决了现有方法的多项局限性，为从H&E图像推断空间基因表达提供了一种高效、统一且性能领先的解决方案。

title: MergeSurv: Merging-Based Continual Learning for Survival Analysis on Whole-Slide Images
summary: Survival analysis on Whole Slide Images (WSIs) is important in computational pathology for prognosis estimation and treatment planning. However, existing survival models are typically trained independently for each cancer cohort, making continual adaptation computationally expensive for gigapixel-scale WSIs. In this study, we propose MergeSurv, a merging-based continual learning framework for WSI survival analysis. A pathology vision-language foundation model is independently fine-tuned on each task, and the learned parameters are sequentially merged into a unified model without storing previous training data. We further investigate two inference strategies: One-for-All (OFA) and Voting-Expert Aggregation (VEA). Experiments on four TCGA cohorts demonstrate that MergeSurv outperforms naive fine-tuning as well as representative regularization-based and rehearsal-based continual learning methods, while effectively reducing catastrophic forgetting. The results suggest that model merging is a promising direction for scalable and privacy-preserving continual learning in computational pathology.

AI.tldr: 提出MergeSurv，一种基于模型合并的持续学习框架，用于全切片图像生存分析，无需存储历史数据即可顺序合并各任务参数，并在四个TCGA数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI生存分析模型通常针对每个癌种独立训练，导致大规模图像上的持续适应计算成本高昂，缺乏高效的持续学习方法。
AI.method: 基于病理视觉-语言基础模型，对每个任务独立微调，然后按顺序合并参数为统一模型。提出两种推理策略：One-For-All（单一模型推理）和Voting-Expert Aggregation（多专家投票聚合）。
AI.result: 在四个TCGA数据集上，MergeSurv优于朴素微调、基于正则化和基于回放的持续学习方法，有效减少灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并是计算病理学中可扩展且隐私保护的持续学习的有前景方向。

title: Continual Model Merging with Test-Time Adaptation for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Model merging offers a practical alternative to conventional continual learning by integrating independently fine-tuned models without retaining previous training data. Recent state-of-the-art model merging methods employ test-time adaptation (TTA-guided merging) to address distribution shifts by adjusting merging-related variables using unlabeled target data. However, these methods have primarily been studied in multi-task or single-target settings, and their behavior under sequential continual learning remains insufficiently understood. We present a benchmark study that maps this family of methods to rehearsal-free continual Whole Slide Image classification and evaluates them against traditional continual-learning approaches. Experiments on six TCGA cancer-subtyping cohorts cover CLASS-IL and TASK-IL scenarios, in-domain and out-of-domain evaluation, and different task orders. The results show that adapting model merging at test time can provide strong task-specific performance and improve retention of previously acquired knowledge without storing historical WSIs. Nevertheless, performance remains sensitive to task order and to the interaction between adaptation on the current distribution and accumulated knowledge. This benchmark identifies model merging with test-time adaptation as a promising direction for continual computational pathology and motivates future methods that balance adaptation to domain shift with explicit preservation of historical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于测试时自适应的模型融合方法在无数据存储的持续全切片图像分类中的应用，实验表明该方法能有效保留已有知识并适应新分布，但对任务顺序敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有模型融合方法主要在多任务或单目标场景下研究，在持续学习场景下的行为理解不足，缺乏在计算病理学领域的基准评估。
AI.method: 构建了面向无数据存储的持续全切片图像分类的基准，在6个TCGA癌症亚型数据集上评估CLASS-IL和TASK-IL场景，包括域内和域外评估以及不同任务顺序。
AI.result: 测试时自适应的模型融合能提供强任务特定性能并改善知识保留，但性能对任务顺序和当前分布适应与已有知识的交互敏感。
AI.conclusion: 模型融合结合测试时自适应是持续计算病理学的一个有前景方向，未来需要平衡域适应与历史知识显式保留的方法。

title: DeGenseGS: Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Real-time, text-promptable 4D reconstruction is indispensable for autonomous surgical interaction. Severe misalignment between semantic meaning and physical anatomy still persists, largely because existing solutions integrate Vision-Language Models into deformable fields via a rigid coupling scheme that tightly binds semantic features to geometric warping. In this paper, we propose DeGenseGS, Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting, a novel framework that independently models semantic evolution and geometric deformation. Specifically, we propose a HexPlane-based spatiotemporal entanglement module that uses shared kinematic latents to synchronize semantic mutations with scene dynamics, while explicitly disentangling semantic updates from geometric deformation. To further ensure robustness against reconstruction artifacts, we devise a Rasterization-Native Semantic Extraction mechanism that infers semantics from topologically continuous feature maps. Additionally, we incorporate an angular-aligned optimization strategy that conforms to the native hyperspherical latent space, thereby preventing semantic distortion. Extensive evaluations on the CholecSeg8k and EndoVis18 datasets demonstrate that DeGenseGS achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our framework yields enhanced geometric completeness and robust semantic-anatomic alignment, enabling spatially continuous segmentation despite drastic tissue deformation and topological transitions.

AI.tldr: 提出DeGenseGS框架，通过几何与语义解耦的4D高斯溅射实现手术场景的实时、文本可提示4D重建，在CholecSeg8k和EndoVis18上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将视觉-语言模型与可变形场刚性耦合，导致语义特征与几何形变紧密绑定，造成语义与物理解剖之间的严重错位。
AI.method: 1) HexPlane时空纠缠模块：通过共享运动学潜变量同步语义变化与场景动态，同时解耦语义更新与几何形变；2) 栅格化原生语义提取机制：从拓扑连续的特征图中推断语义；3) 角度对齐优化策略：符合原生超球面潜空间，防止语义失真。
AI.result: 在CholecSeg8k和EndoVis18数据集上取得SOTA性能，实现增强的几何完整性和稳健的语义-解剖对齐，在剧烈组织形变和拓扑变化下仍能实现空间连续的分割。
AI.conclusion: DeGenseGS通过几何与语义解耦的设计，有效解决了手术场景理解中语义与解剖错位的问题，为自主手术交互提供了可靠的4D重建方案。

title: DGSeg: Dynamic Gating of Semantic-Spatial Guided Predictions for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation aims to predict pixel-wise masks for targets given complex language queries. Existing approaches leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for vision-language reasoning and generate intermediate target cues (e.g., points or boxes) to guide a segmentation model. However, compressing rich reasoning into sparse cues often introduces ambiguity and noise, preventing these cues from accurately preserving the reasoning intent. While multiple complementary cues can enrich target information, existing methods typically feed them jointly into a single segmentation process, allowing ambiguous or erroneous cues to affect the entire prediction. Therefore, we propose DGSeg, a reasoning segmentation framework that learns to fuse predictions guided by semantic and spatial cues. Specifically, the MLLM jointly reasons about both target identity and spatial location, producing complementary semantic and spatial cues that are fed into separate segmentation branches. Their predictions are adaptively integrated by a lightweight dynamic gating module trained with relative branch-quality supervision to suppress noisy or conflicting regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGSeg consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple benchmarks and achieves 69.6% and 67.3% gIoU on the challenging ReasonSeg validation and test splits. Code is available at https://github.com/RZZeng/DGSeg.

AI.tldr: DGSeg是一种推理分割框架，通过MLLM生成互补的语义和空间线索，分别输入独立分割分支，并利用动态门控模块自适应融合预测结果，有效抑制噪声和歧义，在ReasonSeg等基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将复杂推理意图压缩为稀疏线索（如点或框）时存在歧义和噪声问题，且多个线索联合输入单一分割流程会导致错误线索影响整体预测，因此需要更鲁棒的融合策略。
AI.method: 提出DGSeg框架：1）MLLM联合推理目标身份和空间位置，生成语义和空间互补线索；2）两条独立分割分支分别处理不同线索；3）轻量级动态门控模块（受相对分支质量监督训练）自适应集成预测，抑制噪声和冲突区域。
AI.result: 在ReasonSeg验证集和测试集上分别达到69.6%和67.3% gIoU，在多个基准上持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过互补线索分离处理与动态门控融合，有效提升了复杂语言查询下的推理分割精度和鲁棒性。

title: LILAC: Layer-Wise Independent LoRAs and Cascaded Conditioning for Multi-Concept Customization of Diffusion Models
summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models to render several specific subjects in a coherent image remains challenging: the model must preserve each subject's identity while keeping the scene spatially and visually coherent. Methods that fuse independently trained concept adapters in a shared weight space (via federated averaging, gradient fusion, or orthogonality constraints) suffer from identity confusion and style bleeding and require joint retraining. In this work, we show that composing concepts as separate image layers, instead of merging their adapters in a shared weight space, avoids parameter-level interference. We introduce LILAC, a framework that composes independently trained low-rank adapters at inference time: each subject is conditioned on the frozen composite of previously placed subjects, with exactly one adapter active at a time, therefore identities never interfere at the parameter level. LILAC composes the adapters without any joint training, scales linearly with the number of concepts, and is backbone-agnostic. Under the Orthogonal Adaptation protocol, LILAC applied on Qwen-Image-Edit reaches an ArcFace detection rate of 0.861, while Orthogonal Adaptation reports 0.745 in its original setting. Adaptation reports 0.745 in its original setting. Code is available at https://github.com/marianlupascu/LILAC.

AI.tldr: LILAC通过将不同概念作为独立图像层组合（而非共享权重空间），避免了参数级干扰，无需联合训练即可实现多主体文本到图像扩散模型的个性化生成，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（联邦平均、梯度融合等）在共享权重空间中融合独立训练的概念适配器时，存在身份混淆和风格渗透问题，且需要联合重训练。核心难点在于如何在保持场景空间和视觉连贯性的同时，保留每个主体的身份特征。
AI.method: 提出LILAC框架：将每个主体作为独立图像层，推理时组合独立训练的低秩适配器。每个主体基于之前放置主体的冻结复合结果进行条件生成，每次仅激活一个适配器，避免参数级干扰。无需联合训练，复杂度随概念数量线性增长，且与骨干网络无关。
AI.result: 在正交适应协议下，LILAC应用于Qwen-Image-Edit时，ArcFace检测率达到0.861，而正交适应在原始设置下报告为0.745。
AI.conclusion: LILAC通过将概念组合为独立图像层而非共享权重空间，有效解决了多主体文本到图像生成中的身份混淆问题，无需联合训练，具有可扩展性和骨干网络无关性。

title: Hybrid Deep Learning for Traceability and Classification of Industrial Slate Tiles
summary: Applying deep learning to instance-aware reidentification of slate tiles and extraction site classification can improve production efficiency and quality control in the slate tile industry. These tasks are particularly important for handling natural materials where visual variability can make manual inspection costly and error-prone. We present a lightweight, hybrid deep learning approach that combines image matching and classification within a single framework. The system integrates a feature-matching branch based on XFeat with a MobileNetV3- based classification branch. The XFeat branch, combined with a LightGlue matching head, improves instance matching performance by +15.4% AUC. For classification, features from both backbones are shared and fused, resulting in a +10.9% accuracy improvement over a standard MobileNetV3 model. Our approach is evaluated on a newly created industrial dataset consisting of 2,610 slate tile images from six extraction sites. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for object re-identification and classification in an industrial setting.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级混合深度学习方法，结合图像匹配（XFeat+LightGlue）和分类（MobileNetV3）框架，用于板岩瓦片的实例重识别和产地分类，在工业数据集上显著提升了匹配和分类性能。
AI.motivation: 板岩瓦片行业依赖人工目视检测，成本高且易出错，需要自动化方法提升生产效率和质量管理水平。
AI.method: 采用轻量级混合深度学习框架，集成XFeat特征匹配分支（结合LightGlue匹配头）和MobileNetV3分类分支，双分支特征共享与融合。
AI.result: 实例匹配AUC提升15.4%，分类准确率提升10.9%（相对于标准MobileNetV3）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在工业板岩瓦片数据集上验证了有效性，适用于工业场景下的物体重识别与分类任务。

title: PAGE: Towards Practical Human-level Gaze Target Estimation
summary: Gaze target estimation, the task of predicting where a person is looking in a scene, is crucial to understanding human attention and intent. It is a challenging task that combines high-level understanding of global scene semantics and precise spatial reasoning using human appearance (e.g. pose, eye orientation). As a result, human-level performance remains elusive for existing models, limiting their practical application. To this end, we propose PaGE (Practical Gaze Estimator), a gaze estimation model that explicitly models the complex interaction between scene and head features. Using a PaGE model with a large ViT-H+ backbone as the teacher, we further distill student models with lighter backbones on a much larger and more diverse unlabeled dataset. The architectural improvements and novel training recipe allow PaGE to achieve state-of-the-art performance on several gaze estimation tasks, outperforming humans in 7 out of 9 metrics while reducing the human-AI gap by at least 60% in the remaining 2. The distilled student models retain most of the teacher's performance while being lightweight enough for practical deployment on robots and consumer devices. The code and model checkpoints are available at our project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaGE模型，通过显式建模场景与头部特征的复杂交互，并利用大模型蒸馏轻量学生模型，在多项视线估计任务上达到SOTA，7/9指标超越人类表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视线估计模型在理解全局场景语义和精确空间推理上仍无法达到人类水平，限制了实际应用。作者希望缩小人机差距，提升模型在实际场景中的可用性。
AI.method: 1) 提出PaGE模型，显式建模场景与头部特征的复杂交互；2) 使用大ViT-H+骨干作为教师模型；3) 在更大、更多样化的无标签数据集上蒸馏轻量学生模型。
AI.result: 在9项指标中7项超越人类表现，剩余2项将人机差距缩小至少60%；蒸馏学生模型在保持高性能的同时足够轻量，可部署于机器人和消费设备。
AI.conclusion: PaGE通过创新的架构和训练策略显著提升了视线估计性能，代码和模型已开源。

title: Unsupervised Detection of Underground Tunnels in Ground-Penetrating Radar Using Depth-Restricted Reconstruction Scoring
summary: Clandestine tunneling beneath oil and gas pipelines enables fuel theft, smuggling, and sabotage, yet conventional monitoring detects damage only after a pipeline has been compromised. Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) can image such tunnels non-invasively, but manual radargram interpretation does not scale to continuous corridor surveillance, and supervised detectors require tunnel examples that are scarce in practice. We present a fully unsupervised detection pipeline trained exclusively on normal subsurface radargrams collected at a purpose-built field site containing three buried tunnels at 1.5-3 m depth. A denoising convolutional autoencoder learns the structure of anomaly-free ground; at inference, tunnels are flagged by reconstruction error. Our central contribution is a depth-restricted top-k anomaly score, which pools the highest reconstruction errors only within the depth band where tunnels can physically occur. This physically motivated rule raises AUC from 0.986 to 0.994 and cuts missed detections from 74 to 17 of 634 tunnel windows, relative to whole-image scoring, without any retraining or labels. We further show that the optimal top-k fraction interacts with the depth restriction - 1% pooling is best on full images, 5% once scoring is depth-restricted - and that spatial voting across overlapping survey windows helps weak per-image detectors but offers no benefit once the scoring rule is strong. The final system attains AUC 0.994, F1 0.975, recall 0.973, and precision 0.976 on 1,600 field test windows spanning 55 survey lines, at a 1.6% false-alarm rate, using no tunnel labels for training, scoring, or threshold calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种完全无监督的管道下方隧道检测方法，利用去噪卷积自编码器在野外雷达数据上训练，并通过深度限制的top-k异常评分策略，在无任何隧道标签的情况下达到AUC 0.994、F1 0.975的优异性能。
AI.motivation: 油气管道下方的秘密隧道可能导致燃油盗窃、走私和破坏活动，现有监测手段只能在管道被破坏后才发现问题。探地雷达虽然能非侵入性成像隧道，但人工判读雷达图无法规模化，而监督检测方法又因缺乏实际隧道样本而难以应用。
AI.method: 在包含三个埋深1.5-3米隧道的野外场地收集正常地下雷达数据，训练去噪卷积自编码器学习无异常背景结构；推理时通过重建误差检测隧道；核心创新是深度限制的top-k异常评分，仅考虑物理可能的隧道深度范围内的最高重建误差。
AI.result: 深度限制的top-k评分将AUC从0.986提升至0.994，漏检从74处降至17处（共634个隧道窗口）。最终系统在1600个野外测试窗口上达到AUC 0.994、F1 0.975、召回率0.973、精确率0.976，虚警率仅1.6%，全程无需隧道标签。
AI.conclusion: 物理驱动的深度限制策略能显著提升无监督异常检测性能，且无需重新训练或标签信息；空间投票在弱检测器上有用，但在强评分规则下无额外收益。

title: HunyuanOCR-1.5: Making Lightweight OCR VLMs Faster and Better
summary: We present HunyuanOCR-1.5, a lightweight end-to-end OCR-specialized vision-language model. HunyuanOCR unifies document parsing, text spotting, information extraction, text-image translation, and multi-image document understanding within a single end-to-end VLM. Building upon the lightweight architecture of HunyuanOCR-1.0, HunyuanOCR-1.5 does not redesign the backbone, but systematically improves both efficiency and capability. For efficiency, we adapt DFlash to OCR decoding, significantly reducing the latency of long structured outputs such as dense documents, tables, and formulas while preserving output distribution. Powered by DFlash, HunyuanOCR-1.5 achieves a 6.37x Transformer inference speedup and a 2.14x speedup under vLLM, delivering the fastest inference among lightweight OCR VLMs. For capability, we propose Agentic Data Flow, an agent-driven data construction system that transforms model weaknesses into executable data requirements and autonomously performs material search, quality verification, and pipeline development. It substantially improves long-tail capabilities in ancient-script OCR, fine-grained chart and table parsing, multi-image text-centric QA, low-resource multilingual parsing, and document hallucination evaluation. HunyuanOCR-1.5 ranks among the top-tier end-to-end OCR solutions on OmniDocBench v1.6 while achieving new performance milestones across these long-tail tasks. Combined with an upgraded pretraining and post-training recipe, HunyuanOCR-1.5 further extends its capability in high-resolution, long-context, and multi-task scenarios. Experiments demonstrate faster inference, broader OCR capability coverage, and the deployment advantages of a lightweight end-to-end model. We will release the model weights and training code to support future research and real-world OCR applications.

AI.tldr: HunyuanOCR-1.5 是一个轻量级端到端OCR专用视觉语言模型，通过DFlash实现6.37倍推理加速，并提出Agentic Data Flow自主数据构建系统，在多项OCR任务上达到顶尖性能。
AI.motivation: 在保持轻量级架构的基础上，同时提升OCR推理效率和长尾场景能力，解决现有OCR模型在密集文档、表格、公式等长结构化输出场景下推理速度慢，以及古文字OCR、低资源多语言等长尾任务表现不佳的问题。
AI.method: 1) 将DFlash适配到OCR解码中，加速长结构化输出（密集文档、表格、公式）的Transformer推理，实现6.37倍加速，vLLM下2.14倍加速；2) 提出Agentic Data Flow，一种智能体驱动的数据构建系统，自动将模型弱点转化为数据需求并执行材料搜索、质量验证和流程开发。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench v1.6上达到顶级端到端OCR方案水平；在古文字OCR、细粒度图表/表格解析、多图像文本问答、低资源多语言解析等长尾任务上取得新里程碑；在轻量级OCR VLM中实现最快推理速度。
AI.conclusion: HunyuanOCR-1.5通过系统性的效率改进（DFlash）和能力扩展（Agentic Data Flow），在保持轻量级架构优势的同时，实现了更快的推理速度、更广泛的OCR能力覆盖，适合部署到实际应用场景。

title: ProCon: Projection-Consistency Memory for Training-Free Anomaly Detection
summary: Memory-based anomaly detection is attractive because it localizes defects from normal images without training a decoder or synthesizing pseudo anomalies. However, most memory methods still use the memory bank as a nearest-neighbor lookup table: a test patch is treated as normal if it has one nearby normal anchor. This hard retrieval view is vulnerable to false-normal matches and does not test whether the patch is consistently supported by a local normal neighborhood. We propose ProCon, a training-free framework that turns memory retrieval into decoder-free reconstruction. ProCon softly projects each test patch onto nearby normal memory vectors and uses the projection residual as anomaly evidence. To stabilize this residual, it constructs seed-perturbed layer-wise memories, aggregates bank residuals by a median, and fuses depth-specific residual maps by layer consensus. ProCon requires no decoder training, backbone fine-tuning, learned fusion weights, or pseudo-anomaly supervision. Across MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD under the single-category evaluation protocol, ProCon achieves strong image- and pixel-level performance under seven standard metrics, including image AUROC scores of 99.8%, 99.2%, and 93.2%, respectively. Ablations show that the gains come from replacing hard retrieval with soft normal projection and stabilizing the residuals through memory and depth consensus. The code is available at https://github.com/jw-chae/Procon

AI.tldr: ProCon是一种无需训练的无解码器异常检测框架，通过软投影和残差稳定技术，在多个基准数据集上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于记忆的异常检测方法简单地将记忆库当作最近邻查找表，容易受到假正常匹配的干扰，且未能检验测试补丁是否被局部正常邻域一致支持。
AI.method: ProCon将记忆检索转化为无解码器重建：将测试补丁软投影到邻近的正常记忆向量上，用投影残差作为异常证据；通过构造种子扰动的逐层记忆、中位数聚合银行残差、以及逐层共识融合深度残差图来稳定残差。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和Real-IAD数据集上，图像级AUROC分别达到99.8%、99.2%和93.2%，在七项标准指标上均表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 软正常投影替代硬检索以及通过记忆和深度共识稳定残差是性能提升的关键。

title: Virtual Category-Guided Continual Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Continual Generalized Category Discovery (C-GCD) aims to incrementally identify novel categories from sequential unlabeled data while preserving recognition of known classes, which is an essential capability for open-world visual learning. A major bottleneck lies in ambiguous unlabeled samples that cannot be confidently assigned to known classes nor reliably grouped as novel ones, making pseudo-labeling brittle and often biasing learning toward familiar categories. In this work, we introduce Virtual Category-Guided Continual Generalized Category Discovery by adapting Virtual Category Learning (VCL) to the continual setting. Our method identifies uncertain samples and assigns them to temporary virtual categories, enabling safe and informative learning from unlabeled streams without injecting noisy labels, while improving unlabeled data utilization and mitigating prediction bias. To further stabilize discovery across sessions and enhance class separation, we augment VCL with Expanded Neighborhood Contrastive Learning (ENCL), which exploits extended neighborhood relations and an adaptive margin to learn more discriminative and well-separated representations for both old and emerging classes. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet-100 demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a scalable and effective solution for C-GCD.

AI.tldr: 本文针对持续广义类别发现（C-GCD）任务，提出虚拟类别引导的方法（VCL+ENCL），通过虚拟类别处理模糊样本并结合扩展邻域对比学习，显著提升了在无标签数据流中识别新类别并保留旧类别知识的能力。
AI.motivation: C-GCD任务中，模糊的无标签样本难以被自信地归为已知类或新类，导致伪标签脆弱且学习偏向熟悉类别，现有方法存在数据利用率低和预测偏差问题。
AI.method: 提出虚拟类别学习（VCL）将不确定样本分配到临时虚拟类别以避免噪声标签；并引入扩展邻域对比学习（ENCL），利用扩展邻域关系和自适应边界学习更具判别性和分离性的表示。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet-100上，该方法持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为C-GCD提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案，兼顾了已知类保留与未知类发现。

title: Geometry-aware Depth-guided Representation Learning for Structure-preserving Low-light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light degradation reduces image visibility and weakens structural cues that are important for visual representation and scene understanding. Existing low-light image enhancement methods mainly focus on appearance restoration, while insufficiently exploiting scene geometry to preserve structural consistency. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a Depth-guided Multi-scale Attention Network (DMSA-Net) for geometry-aware low-light image enhancement. DMSA-Net introduces depth-related structural priors into low-light representation learning through reflectance-geometry interaction. A Retinex-based decomposition module is first used to obtain illumination-invariant reflectance representations, from which depth cues are inferred to characterize scene structure under degraded illumination. A multi-scale depth-guided fusion strategy is then embedded into a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture, where depth-aware attention adaptively integrates geometric and appearance features. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that DMSA-Net achieves effective low-light restoration while improving structural preservation. Moreover, we construct LOL-D, a depth-augmented low-light dataset, to facilitate research on geometry-aware low-light vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出深度引导的多尺度注意力网络（DMSA-Net），通过引入深度结构先验实现几何感知的低光图像增强，在恢复外观的同时保持结构一致性，并构建了带深度标注的低光数据集LOL-D。
AI.motivation: 现有低光增强方法主要关注外观恢复，未能充分利用场景几何信息来保持结构一致性，导致结构线索被弱化。
AI.method: 提出DMSA-Net：先利用Retinex分解模块获取光照不变反射图并推断深度线索；再通过多尺度深度引导融合策略，在编解码器中嵌入深度感知注意力机制，自适应整合几何与外观特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，DMSA-Net在实现有效低光恢复的同时，显著改善了结构保留效果。同时构建了LOL-D深度增强低光数据集。
AI.conclusion: 将深度几何先验融入低光增强能有效提升结构一致性，为几何感知的低光视觉任务提供了新思路和数据基础。

title: Unsupervised Pixel-Level Semantic Left-Right Understanding of In-the-Wild Images
summary: While various works address reflective symmetry understanding in 3D data and images, pixel-level semantic left-right prediction of in-the-wild images remains challenging, due to certain difficulties including the lack of 3D information, occlusion, object pose variation, partiality, etc. In this work, we propose an unsupervised learning framework to tackle this challenge. Leveraging recent advances in vertex-wise semantic left-right understanding of 3D data, our unsupervised learning method jointly utilises 3D shape and image datasets to infer pixel-wise semantic left-right predictions in single-view images. In particular, we show that a medium-scale 3D shape dataset comprising mainly of human- and quadruped animal-like shapes, combined with diverse in-the-wild image data, are sufficient to achieve high-quality semantic left-right prediction in images, even for entirely unseen 3D object categories, such as cars or trains. Overall, our approach achieves superior performance in dense pixel-wise semantic left-right predictions on both rendered and in-the-wild image datasets when compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无监督学习框架，利用3D形状数据与图像数据相结合，实现单视图图像中像素级语义左右预测，在渲染和自然图像上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽能处理3D数据和图像中的反射对称性，但缺乏3D信息、遮挡、物体姿态变化和局部性等因素使得像素级语义左右预测仍具挑战。
AI.method: 利用3D数据中顶点级语义左右理解，通过无监督学习联合使用3D形状数据集和图像数据集，将3D知识迁移至2D图像，实现像素级预测。
AI.result: 使用包含人类和四足动物形状的中等规模3D数据集结合多样化自然图像，即可实现高质量预测，甚至能推广到未见过的3D类别（如汽车、火车），在渲染和自然图像数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了3D形状数据与图像数据结合的无监督学习策略在像素级语义左右预测任务上的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Consistent and Editable: A Balanced Framework for Text-Guided Video Editing
summary: Recently, diffusion models have achieved considerable success in the text-guided video editing domain. However, existing works often struggle to balance the trade-off between temporal consistency and editability in video editing, with consistency and editability typically being inversely related. To address this, we propose a high-quality video editing framework enhanced for consistency and editability, named EquiEdit, which improves coordinatively the temporal consistency and editability of the edited videos while achieving a balance between the two. In terms of temporal consistency, the proposed temporal Mamba module with a tailored temporal-aware scanning scans fused video sequences following four designed directions, effectively enhancing the inter-frame consistency of edited videos. For editability, we design a noise injection strategy based on the spectral transformation to increase editing flexibility, where the Fourier transform is used to preserve the hidden structure in the initial latent noise used for editing, ensuring inter-frame consistency of the edited video and fidelity to the input video. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in terms of temporal consistency and editability, as well as its great fidelity to the input video itself.

AI.tldr: 提出EquiEdit框架，通过时间Mamba模块和频谱变换的噪声注入策略，协同提升视频编辑的时间一致性和可编辑性，并在两者间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导视频编辑方法难以平衡时间一致性与可编辑性，两者通常呈负相关关系。
AI.method: 1) 时间Mamba模块：采用四方向扫描策略增强帧间一致性；2) 基于频谱变换的噪声注入策略：利用傅里叶变换保留初始潜噪声中的隐藏结构，提高编辑灵活性。
AI.result: 定性和定量实验表明，该方法在时间一致性、可编辑性以及对输入视频的保真度方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: EquiEdit有效平衡了视频编辑中的一致性与可编辑性，实现了高质量的视频编辑效果。

title: LangLoc: "Tell Me What You See"
comment: Accepted at the European Conference of Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: We tackle fine-grained indoor localization from natural language: given a free-form description of one's surroundings, estimate the observer's 2D position and heading within a known 3D environment. Language queries are lightweight, privacy-preserving, and need no camera - yet prior work stops at coarse scene retrieval and cannot resolve an intra-scene pose. We close this gap with LangLoc, a three-stage pipeline that (i) retrieves the correct scene via a dual-branch GATv2 encoder with CLIP semantic features, surpassing the previous best by 8 percentage points in Top-1 recall; (ii) estimates position and heading by scoring a dense floor grid through ray-cast object visibility, reaching a median error of 0.95 m; and (iii) resolves residual ambiguity through a Bayesian dialog module that asks targeted yes/no questions and updates a pose posterior until the location is pinpointed. To support this task we contribute a benchmark of $13{,}000{+}$ pose-indexed natural-language descriptions over $1{,}300{+}$ indoor 3D scans.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LangLoc，一个三阶段流水线，从自然语言描述中实现细粒度室内定位（2D位置和朝向），首次将语言查询精度提升至子米级（中位误差0.95m），并通过贝叶斯对话模块进一步消除歧义。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅能实现粗粒度的场景检索（判断在哪个房间），无法解决同一场景内的精确位姿估计。语言查询具有轻量、隐私保护、无需摄像头等优势，但缺乏高精度定位能力。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(i) 双分支GATv2编码器+CLIP语义特征进行场景检索；(ii) 通过射线投射物体可见性对密集地板网格评分估计位姿；(iii) 贝叶斯对话模块通过提问yes/no问题更新后验消除歧义。
AI.result: 场景检索Top-1召回率超越此前最佳8个百分点；位姿估计中位误差0.95米；构建了包含13,000+条自然语言描述、覆盖1,300+室内3D扫描的基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: LangLoc首次实现了从自然语言到室内细粒度定位的完整解决方案，验证了语言查询在隐私保护和轻量化方面的潜力，为免摄像头室内定位开辟了新方向。

title: RADIANCE: Relative Adaptive Denoising with IP-Adapter for Novel Concept Enhancement
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved striking progress but still struggle to synthesize rare concepts involving unusual attribute-object pairings, often resulting in concept omission or semantic drift where a dominant entity overwhelms the generation. Tracing these failures to a lack of compositional balance during the denoising trajectory, we propose RADIANCE, a training-free framework that treats inference as a closed-loop feedback process. RADIANCE augments pretrained backbones with three modular components: (1) a Compositional Similarity Monitor (CSM) that tracks the emergence of objects and attributes in intermediate latents via CLIP-based feedback; (2) a Bidirectional Scale Controller (BSC) that applies a reactive "restoring force" using positive and negative IP-Adapter scales to rebalance biased trajectories; and (3) a Feedback Guidance Scheduler (FGS) that coordinates these updates across timesteps without additional training. We further extend the framework to multi-object prompts via Delayed Adapter Activation (DAA) and Layer-wise Alternating Guidance (LAG) to prevent premature concept fusion. By overlapping monitoring and denoising through pipelined execution, RADIANCE maintains competitive latency while significantly enhancing the per-sample success rate and effective throughput. Experiments on RareBench and T2I-CompBench demonstrate that RADIANCE consistently enhances compositional alignment and perceptual quality over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: RADIANCE是一个无需训练的框架，通过闭环反馈过程增强扩散模型的组合生成能力，能有效解决罕见概念合成中的属性-对象配对失衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的T2I扩散模型在生成罕见概念（不寻常的属性-对象组合）时，常出现概念遗漏或语义漂移问题，这是由于去噪轨迹中缺乏组合平衡所致。
AI.method: 提出RADIANCE框架，包含三个核心模块：组合相似度监控器（CSM）、双向尺度控制器（BSC）和反馈引导调度器（FGS），并针对多目标提示引入延迟适配器激活（DAA）和层级交替引导（LAG）。
AI.result: 在RareBench和T2I-CompBench上，RADIANCE在组合对齐和感知质量方面持续优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RADIANCE通过闭环反馈机制有效提升了扩散模型在复杂组合生成任务中的表现，且无需额外训练。

title: TimeThink: Reasoning with Time for Video LLMs
summary: Video reasoning requires models to identify and verify temporally localized evidence within long video sequences. Recent Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have shown promising reasoning abilities when aligned with reinforcement learning, yet existing approaches typically rely on outcome-based rewards that supervise only the final prediction. Such supervision provides limited guidance on how models should discover the relevant temporal evidence during intermediate reasoning. In this work, we propose TimeThink, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly guides temporal evidence discovery in Video-LLMs. Our key idea is to treat temporal clue steps as the fundamental optimization primitive of video reasoning, where each reasoning step references a candidate time interval in the video. We introduce a step-wise temporal process reward that provides localized credit assignment for these clues and a joint process--outcome optimization objective that balances reasoning fidelity with task correctness. To enable scalable training, we construct TimeThink-RFT-20K, a dataset with automatically derived temporal evidence segments. Extensive experiments across video reasoning, temporal grounding, and general video understanding benchmarks show that TimeThink consistently improves both temporal localization and reasoning performance, achieving state-of-the-art results among open-source video RL models.

AI.tldr: TimeThink提出了一种基于强化学习的视频推理框架，通过对时间线索步骤进行过程奖励，显式引导Video-LLM发现视频中的时序证据，在多个基准上取得了最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的Video-LLM强化学习方法仅使用基于最终预测的结果奖励，缺乏对中间推理过程中时序证据发现的引导。
AI.method: 将时间线索步骤视为视频推理的基本优化单元，引入步骤级时序过程奖励进行局部信用分配，并提出过程-结果联合优化目标，同时构建了TimeThink-RFT-20K数据集。
AI.result: 在视频推理、时序定位和通用视频理解等多个基准上，TimeThink一致提升了时序定位和推理性能，在开源视频RL模型中达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 显式引导时序证据发现能够显著提升Video-LLM的视频推理能力，过程奖励比单纯的结果奖励更有效。

title: Be Indiscrete: The Benefits of Learning Continuous Spine Degeneration Severity Scores
summary: Lumbar spine degeneration is a major contributor to chronic low back pain and is routinely assessed on MRI using ordinal grading systems, e.g. normal, mild, moderate, severe. Consequently, most approaches to train models to grade these MRIs formulate grading as a multi-class classification problem, treating ordinal grades as categorical, ignoring differences in misclassification severity, and imposing hard decision boundaries on a continuous disease process. This work explores modeling spinal degeneration as a continuous severity ranking problem. We introduce SpineRankNet, a framework that learns scalar severity scores from lumbar spinal MRI, and compare it against multi-class classification and ordinal regression. Using multiple degeneration measures from the Genodisc dataset, we show that a model trained using a ranking loss to produce a continuous score enables fine-grained ordering of MRI scans. Furthermore, the ordinal grading classes can be recovered from the score with comparable accuracy to those from a model trained directly for classification. The score learned by ranking even improves discrimination between more distant classes. Source code is available at https://github.com/spinetools/spineranknet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpineRankNet框架，将腰椎退行性变从传统的多分类问题转化为连续严重程度排序问题，通过排名损失学习标量严重程度分数，实现对MRI扫描的细粒度排序，并能以可比精度恢复序数分级。
AI.motivation: 传统基于MRI的腰椎退变分级采用序数分级（如正常、轻度、中度、重度），但将其作为多分类问题处理忽略了分级间的差异严重性和连续疾病过程的硬决策边界，需要更合理的连续建模方法。
AI.method: 提出SpineRankNet框架，使用排名损失（ranking loss）从腰椎MRI中学习连续的标量严重程度分数，并与多分类和序数回归方法进行比较。
AI.result: 排名损失训练的连续评分模型实现了MRI扫描的细粒度排序；从分数中恢复的序数分级精度与直接分类训练相当；排名学习的分数在区分更远距离类别时表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 将脊柱退变建模为连续严重程度排序问题比传统多分类方法更合理，能提供更细粒度的信息且不损失分级精度。

title: Semantic Video Communication via Multi-Scale Convolution and Dynamic Routing for Next-Generation Networks
comment: Accepted at the AAAI 2026 Workshop on AI for Time Series (AI4TS)
summary: The exponential growth of video traffic demands novel semantic communication paradigms that transmit meaning rather than raw bits. We present a generative AI-enabled framework for semantic video communication addressing two critical challenges: efficient hierarchical temporal modeling for bandwidth-constrained transmission and robust semantic alignment between video content and natural language queries at network edge devices. Our approach introduces a multi-scale temporal convolutional encoder that captures motion patterns across different temporal granularities with O(T) complexity suitable for resource-constrained IoT deployments. We further propose a capsule-based dynamic routing mechanism that iteratively refines segment-query associations, enabling flexible modeling of non-monotonic semantic alignments essential for goal-oriented communication. These components are unified through a multi-task learning objective optimizing temporal boundary regression, cross-modal alignment, and capsule diversity. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions demonstrate significant improvements, achieving 42.9% Recall@0.5 and 41.1% mean IoU while maintaining computational efficiency critical for edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向语义视频通信的生成式AI框架，通过多尺度时序卷积编码器和胶囊动态路由机制，在资源受限的边缘设备上实现高效的分层级时序建模与语义对齐，在ActivityNet Captions数据集上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 视频流量指数级增长，传统通信传输原始比特而非语义，效率低下；同时，在带宽受限的边缘设备上，需要一种既能高效建模视频时序结构，又能实现视频内容与自然语言查询间鲁棒语义对齐的新范式。
AI.method: 提出了多尺度时序卷积编码器（复杂度O(T)）用于捕获不同时间粒度的运动模式；设计基于胶囊的动态路由机制，迭代优化片段-查询关联以实现非单调语义对齐；通过多任务学习目标统一优化时序边界回归、跨模态对齐和胶囊多样性。
AI.result: 在ActivityNet Captions数据集上，Recall@0.5达到42.9%，mean IoU达到41.1%，同时保持了边缘部署所需的高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 该生成式AI框架有效解决了带宽受限场景下视频语义通信的关键挑战，为资源受限的边缘设备上的目标导向通信提供了可行方案。

title: Green for Go, Red for No: Visual Grounding via Semantic Segmentation for VLA Navigation Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robot navigation from natural language and visual goals, but remain susceptible to perceptual distractions and ambiguous scene interpretations. This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of visual grounding for VLA navigation policies. We propose a real-time segmentation-based grounding method that highlights traversable areas in green and non-traversable areas in red using SegFormer. Two variants are evaluated: observation-only segmentation and joint observation-goal augmentation. Using OmniVLA on the Grand Tour dataset, we show that visual grounding reduces the mean waypoint error by 27-44% at the farthest waypoint, depending on the instruction length. The benefits are greater for long instructions than for short instructions, and grounding provides little improvement for image goals. Normalized error analysis indicates that grounding primarily acts as a trajectory length regularizer, reducing the predicted path length by 30% without improving per-unit-distance reasoning. Our results indicate that visual grounding offers a simple, computationally inexpensive method to improve VLA navigation without model retraining, although it cannot compensate for missing training signals in out-of-distribution instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证评估了视觉基础（visual grounding）对VLA导航策略的影响，提出基于SegFormer的实时分割方法，在OmniVLA上验证可将最远航点误差降低27-44%，同时轨迹长度减少30%。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人导航中易受感知干扰和场景歧义影响，现有方法缺乏对视觉基础能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 使用SegFormer进行实时语义分割，将可通行区域标记为绿色、不可通行区域标记为红色；设计了仅观测分割和观测-目标联合增强两种方案，在Grand Tour数据集上用OmniVLA进行评估。
AI.result: 最远航点平均误差降低27-44%；长指令下效果优于短指令；图像目标下改进有限；预测路径长度缩短30%，但每单位距离的推理能力未提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础是一种简单、计算成本低且无需重新训练模型即可提升VLA导航性能的方法，但无法补偿分布外指令中缺失的训练信号。

title: Claim-Level Rubric Rewards for Video Caption Reinforcement Learning
summary: In this paper, we introduce Claim-Level Rubric Rewards (CuRe), a structured reward framework designed to address the reward-design bottleneck in reinforcement learning for dense video captioning. Existing reward designs generally fall into two categories: holistic response-level judgment across heterogeneous criteria, or alignment-based evaluation against reference captions. However, both paradigms suffer from fundamental limitations. Holistic rewards struggle to ensure factual accuracy and are prone to stylistic reward hacking, while reference-based rewards overly rely on rigid textual alignment, failing to preserve the completeness and diversity inherent to open-ended generation tasks. To address these challenges, CuRe reformulates reward modeling as fine-grained claim-level verification. Specifically, CuRe decomposes captions into category-aware atomic claims through a structured rubric, converting holistic evaluation into simpler and more reliable claim-level verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Claim-Level Rubric Rewards (CuRe)，一种结构化的奖励框架，通过将密集视频字幕生成的奖励建模细化为细粒度的声明级别验证，解决了强化学习中奖励设计的瓶颈问题，克服了整体式奖励和基于参考的奖励各自的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励设计存在根本性缺陷：整体式奖励难以确保事实准确性且易受风格奖励欺骗，而基于参考的奖励过度依赖严格的文本对齐，无法保留开放生成任务的完整性和多样性。
AI.method: CuRe将字幕分解为类别感知的原子声明，通过结构化规则将整体评估转化为更简单可靠的声明级别验证。
AI.result: CuRe通过细粒度声明级验证解决了奖励设计瓶颈，提升了奖励模型的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: CuRe为密集视频字幕生成的强化学习提供了一种更有效的奖励设计范式。

title: An event-driven framework for fly-inspired visual motion detection
summary: Fast and reliable motion detection is essential for machine vision and autonomous systems operating in dynamic environments. This work integrates emerging event-based sensing with biologically structured neural computation to establish an efficient computational paradigm for visual motion detection. The proposed framework is built upon a recently developed fly-inspired neural network that emulates motion-processing circuits in the optic lobe. Owing to its feed-forward and training-free architecture, the neural model requires only a small number of interpretable parameters and is well suited for real-time embedded implementation. Event cameras provide low-latency, low-power, and high-dynamic-range visual sensing by asynchronously transmitting brightness-change events. However, their performance can be degraded by event noise, including temporal noise and junction-leakage-induced activity, particularly under low-light conditions. Moreover, effective integration between event-based visual representations and biologically inspired neural processing remains under-explored. To address these challenges, we propose an event-driven computational framework that combines time-surface encoding for front-end event representation with a fly optic-lobe-inspired neural network for foreground motion-direction estimation. A bottom-up attention mechanism is further incorporated to suppress background motion and enhance the saliency of foreground targets. The proposed method is evaluated on real-world ground-vehicle datasets and compared with a baseline frame-based model and an optimization-based approach. Experimental results demonstrate that the framework effectively combines the temporal advantages of event-driven vision with the efficiency and interpretability of bio-inspired neural processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合事件相机和果蝇神经网络的运动检测框架，利用时间表面编码和注意力机制，在真实数据集上验证了其高效性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在低光下易受噪声干扰，且事件视觉与生物启发神经处理的集成尚不充分，需要一种高效、可解释的运动检测方案。
AI.method: 采用时间表面编码进行前端事件表征，结合果蝇视叶启发的神经网络进行前景运动方向估计，并引入自底向上注意力机制抑制背景运动。
AI.result: 在真实地面车辆数据集上，所提框架优于基线帧模型和优化方法，有效结合了事件视觉的时间优势与生物神经处理的效率与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了事件驱动视觉与生物启发计算融合的可行性，为实时嵌入式运动检测提供了新范式。

title: Probing Geospatial SSL Representations with Environmental Signals
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is designed to learn generic, transferable representations rather than representations optimized for a single task. Most geospatial benchmarks evaluate representations solely through downstream tasks, providing limited insight into the information encoded within the representation itself. We ask a different question: do SSL representations of satellite imagery preserve statistical associations with environmental variables that co-vary with the imaging process? To answer this question, we probe SSL representations using co-located ERA5 reanalysis variables, a global dataset of physically consistent environmental variables, including temperature, precipitation, surface solar radiation, surface pressure, and volumetric soil water. These variables are physically related to the spectral reflectance and radar backscatter recorded by Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, making them meaningful evaluation targets despite not being used during SSL pretraining. We complement this probing analysis with intrinsic representation metrics to characterize representation geometry and investigate how these properties relate to downstream performance and the encoding of environmental signals. Using DINO, MAE, and MoCo models trained under identical conditions, we show that representation-level metrics distinguish models with similar downstream benchmark performance, providing complementary information beyond task-driven benchmarks. We further find that the linear accessibility of environmental signals is associated with performance on environmentally dependent tasks in the PANGAEA benchmark. Finally, we release ERA5 annotations co-located with the SSL4EO dataset to enable physically grounded representation evaluation for future geospatial foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨自监督学习（SSL）在卫星图像表示中是否保留了与环境变量的统计关联，并通过ERA5再分析数据对DINO、MAE、MoCo模型进行探测分析，发现表示级指标能区分下游性能相似的模型，且环境信号的可线性访问性与环境依赖任务的性能相关。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间基准主要通过下游任务评估表示质量，对表示本身编码的信息了解有限。作者希望探究SSL卫星图像表示是否保留了与环境变量的统计关联。
AI.method: 使用共定位的ERA5再分析变量（温度、降水、太阳辐射、地表压力、土壤水）探测DINO、MAE、MoCo三种SSL模型的表示，结合表示几何的内在度量指标，分析环境信号的可线性访问性及其与下游任务性能的关系。
AI.result: 表示级指标能区分下游性能相似的模型；环境信号的可线性访问性与PANGAEA基准中环境依赖任务的性能存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理的环境信号探测为表示质量评估提供了超越任务驱动基准的补充信息，作者发布了与SSL4EO数据集共定位的ERA5标注以支持未来研究。

title: A Multimodal Reasoning Typology for Grounding Chart-Image Coherence in Science Communication
summary: Charts and images appear together throughout scientific publications, yet most computational work does not characterize their coherence. We argue that a chart, its accompanying image, and the caption that links them form a multimodal unit, and that the inferential work required to read it varies systematically. To capture this variation, we develop a typology of reasoning gaps, R1 through R5, that characterizes how chart, image, and text jointly convey a scientific claim, and the interpretive work this demands of the reader. Some pairs restate the same data, while in other pairs, charts are used to quantify a structure the image localizes, project image content onto an external variable, audit an image-based claim, or jointly construct a frame that neither panel can establish alone. The typology is anchored in the grounding theory of communication and was derived bottom-up, with a neuroscience expert, from a corpus of 79 traumatic brain injury papers and 32 chart-image pairs. Crucially, the levels provide a systematic mechanism for identifying where grounding succeeds or breaks down, rather than leaving it to subjective inference. We show this in a study in which a domain expert and three non-experts judge vision-language model (VLM) descriptions of 25 pairs: the level predicts where their judgments align and where they diverge, isolating the points at which contextual knowledge, not the figure, carries coherence. This typology thus offers figure designers a systematic way to balance text against chart-image pairs, bridging the expert-to-non-expert divide in reading a scientific takeaway.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从R1到R5的推理缺口类型学，用于系统描述科学文献中图表、图像与文本之间的多模态语义关系及其对读者理解的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管图表和图像在科学出版物中经常同时出现，但现有计算研究很少系统刻画它们之间的连贯性，缺乏对其共同传达科学主张时所需推理性工作的理解。
AI.method: 基于接地理论，通过神经科学专家从79篇创伤性脑损伤论文中自下而上构建了32对图表-图像对的类型学（R1-R5），并通过视觉语言模型描述实验验证了不同推理层级对专家与非专家判断一致性的影响。
AI.result: 不同类型（R1-R5）系统预测了领域专家与非专家在判断上的对齐与分歧点，揭示了哪些部分的信息连贯性来自上下文知识而非图形本身。
AI.conclusion: 该类型学为图表设计师提供了平衡文本与图对的系统方法，有助于弥合专家与非专家在科学信息解读上的鸿沟。

title: Vision Pretraining for Dense Spatial Perception
summary: Dense spatial perception is essential for physical intelligence, where visual systems are expected to recover structured, metric, and actionable representations from pixel observations. Modern visual foundation models tend to prioritize semantic invariance, often at the expense of detailed spatial understanding. In this work, we study vision pretraining through a boundary-centric lens, motivated by the premise that boundaries and shape discontinuities offer essential cues for perceiving geometric properties. Concretely, we propose masked boundary modeling, a self-supervised paradigm that dynamically learns sub-pixel boundary representations and subsequently leverages the discovered boundary-bearing tokens as masked targets to facilitate dense visual token learning. By scaling this framework, we develop LingBot-Vision and demonstrate its efficacy across a diverse set of downstream vision tasks with DINOv3 as a strong baseline. Remarkably, LingBot-Vision drives the progression from LingBot-Depth 1.0 to LingBot-Depth 2.0 for depth completion, and thereby yields enhanced depth estimation, a key pillar for embodied artificial intelligence. Our findings reveal that boundary modeling goes beyond simple line segments and instead serves as a scalable pretraining principle for learning spatially structured visual representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出掩码边界建模（Masked Boundary Modeling）这一自监督预训练范式，通过动态学习亚像素边界表示并将其作为掩码目标，增强视觉模型的空间感知能力。基于该方法开发的LingBot-Vision在多项下游任务中超越DINOv3基线，并推动了深度补全模型从1.0到2.0的演进，显著提升了深度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型倾向于语义不变性，牺牲了细致的空间理解能力。论文认为边界和形状不连续性是感知几何属性的关键线索，因此希望通过边界建模来提升密集空间感知能力。
AI.method: 提出掩码边界建模（Masked Boundary Modeling），一种自监督范式：动态学习亚像素级别的边界表示，然后将包含边界的token作为掩码目标，促进密集视觉token的学习。在此基础上扩展为LingBot-Vision框架。
AI.result: 以DINOv3为强基线，LingBot-Vision在多项下游视觉任务中表现优异。同时推动了深度补全模型从LingBot-Depth 1.0到2.0的进步，深度估计效果显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 边界建模不仅仅是简单的线段检测，而是能够作为学习空间结构化视觉表示的可扩展预训练原则。

title: Repurposing CLIP to Localize at Pixel Level
summary: Large-scale Vision-Language Models like CLIP have demonstrated impressive open-set localization capabilities at the image level. However, adapting this capability to pixel-level dense prediction poses challenges due to global feature biases. In this paper, we introduce CLIPix, a simple yet effective framework that repurposes CLIP to perform pixel-level localization. By tracing back CLIP's classification process, CLIPix identifies object-specific attentive regions and repurposes them as pixel-level localization cues. To address noise introduced by global biases, we propose a Noise-Resistant Correction strategy, refining these cues for more precise segmentation. Additionally, we introduce a Localization Embedding strategy to integrate both localization and enriched detail information, enabling accurate, high-resolution segmentation. Our approach preserves CLIP's generalization strength and unlocks its potential for segmenting arbitrary objects. Extensive experiments on the PASCAL and COCO datasets demonstrate that CLIPix achieves state-of-the-art performance, underscoring its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: CLIPix 通过回溯 CLIP 的分类过程并引入抗噪声校正策略，将其从图像级定位能力扩展到像素级分割，在 PASCAL 和 COCO 数据集上达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 Vision-Language 模型（如 CLIP）在图像层面具备优秀的开放集定位能力，但由于全局特征偏差，难以直接应用于像素级的密集预测任务。
AI.method: 1) 回溯 CLIP 分类过程，提取目标特定的注意力区域作为像素级定位线索；2) 提出噪声抗性校正策略以消除全局偏差引入的噪声；3) 引入定位嵌入策略，融合定位信息与细节信息，实现高分辨率分割。
AI.result: 在 PASCAL 和 COCO 数据集上达到 SOTA 性能，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CLIPix 在保留 CLIP 泛化能力的同时，成功解锁其对任意物体进行分割的潜力，是一种简洁有效的像素级定位框架。

title: FlowMark: Mask-Guided Video Watermarking
summary: We present FlowMark, a video watermarking framework guided by automatically predicted object masks. In contrast to prior region-based approaches that require user-supplied mask guidance, FlowMark learns to identify optimal regions for watermark embedding through a dedicated Mask Predictor network. Our end-to-end trainable architecture combines region-aware encoding with noise-augmented training to ensure robustness against compression, geometric transformations, and content variation, while preserving high perceptual quality. Our content-adaptive masking keeps watermark signals coherent with natural video dynamics, effectively eliminating perceptual flicker. Beyond compression robustness, FlowMark maintains reliable watermark recovery under video-native temporal edits (e.g., frame swap, insertion, deletion, resampling, and interpolation) and real-world social media distribution pipelines (e.g., YouTube and Facebook re-encoding). Experimental results on both image and video datasets show that FlowMark reliably embeds $128$-bit messages with up to $50.08$ dB PSNR, offering strong performance for content provenance, temporal authenticity verification, and video integrity protection.

AI.tldr: FlowMark是一种由自动预测对象掩码引导的视频水印框架，通过端到端训练学习识别最优水印嵌入区域，在保持高感知质量的同时抵抗压缩、几何变换和时间编辑攻击，最高可在50.08 dB PSNR下嵌入128比特消息。
AI.motivation: 现有基于区域的水印方法需要用户手动提供掩码引导，缺乏自动化和自适应性，且难以应对视频特有的时间编辑攻击（如帧交换、插入、删除等）以及社交媒体再编码场景。
AI.method: 提出端到端可训练架构，包含Mask Predictor网络自动学习最优水印嵌入区域；采用区域感知编码器结合噪声增强训练，确保对压缩、几何变换和内容变化的鲁棒性；内容自适应掩码机制使水印信号与自然视频动态保持时空一致，消除感知闪烁。
AI.result: 在图像和视频数据集上，FlowMark可可靠嵌入128比特消息，PSNR最高达50.08 dB；在YouTube和Facebook等社交媒体再编码、帧交换/插入/删除/重采样等时间编辑攻击下均保持可靠的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FlowMark为内容来源认证、时间真实性验证和视频完整性保护提供了强性能方案。

title: Learning Probabilistic Embeddings for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
summary: This paper concerns the problem of unsupervised temporal action segmentation for long, untrimmed videos. Recent successful approaches follow a joint representation learning and clustering paradigm, where optimal transport (OT) is adopted to produce pseudo labels for learning frame representations. These approaches alternate between estimating pseudo labels using OT and optimizing the parameters with gradient descent during training, where OT is used for obtaining the final temporal action segmentation. A major limitation of these works is that they learn a deterministic embedding for frame representations. The iterative procedure between learning deterministic embeddings based on pseudo labels and estimating pseudo labels from the learned embedding can thus get quickly stuck in a local optimum. As an alternative, we thus propose to learn a probabilistic embedding for frame representations. The embeddings are modeled by Gaussian distributions and we sample from the distributions before estimating the pseudo labels. We evaluate our approach on several challenging temporal action segmentation datasets and achieve results comparable to, and in some cases, better than the state of the art. Compared to baselines with deterministic embeddings, our approach improves MoF up to 20.7\% and F1-score up to 19.0\%. Our code is available at https://github.com/derkbreeze/PEOT.

AI.tldr: 提出概率嵌入代替确定性嵌入，通过高斯分布采样解决无监督时序动作分割中迭代优化易陷入局部最优的问题，在多个数据集上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于最优传输的无监督时序动作分割方法学习确定性帧嵌入，导致伪标签估计与嵌入学习迭代过程易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 将帧表示建模为高斯分布（概率嵌入），在估计伪标签前从分布中采样，替代原有的确定性嵌入方式。
AI.result: 在多个时序动作分割数据集上达到或超越SOTA，相比确定性嵌入基线，MoF提升最高20.7%，F1-score提升最高19.0%。
AI.conclusion: 概率嵌入能有效缓解迭代优化中的局部最优问题，显著提升无监督时序动作分割性能。

title: SteelBench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models in Real-World Industrial Environments
summary: Existing video benchmarks evaluate action recognition on consumer videos, egocentric recordings, or simulated industrial environments. They do not test vision-language models under the visual and procedural conditions of real industrial CCTV, where workers appear as distant figures amid dust, steam, low light, glare, occlusion, and overlapping activities. We introduce STEELBENCH, a diagnostic benchmark for industrial surveillance that jointly evaluates per-worker activity recognition, safety-rule reasoning, and annotation provenance. SteelBench contains 1,345 densely annotated clips, curated from 149 hours of operational plant footage and 10,024 candidate clips using temporal deduplication, class balancing, and visibility-aware stratified sampling. Each clip includes dense per-worker action labels, PPE attributes, spatial context, and safety-rule annotations. Because model-assisted annotation can shape the labels later used for model evaluation, SteelBench includes a provenance-aware audit protocol. The protocol measures label influence, evaluates sensitivity to ground-truth provenance, and reports a human reference from expert-reviewed labels. Applying this audit, we find that unaudited VLM-sourced ground truth can inflate same-family model accuracy by up to 17 percentage points. Across nine VLMs from four architectural families, the best model reaches only 42.6% action accuracy, compared with an 84.6% human benchmark. Performance also fragments across recognition, robustness, calibration, and safety reasoning. Even when models predict the correct action, 37-58% of cases still yield incorrect safety judgments, and no model passes more than 2 of 5 diagnostic checks. The dataset is publicly available on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: STEELBENCH是一个针对工业监控场景的视觉-语言模型诊断基准。它包含1,345个密集标注的片段，涵盖工人行为识别、安全规则推理和标注来源审计。实验表明，未审计的模型生成标注会使同系列模型准确率虚高17%，最佳模型行为识别准确率仅42.6%（人类84.6%），且37-58%的正确行为预测仍导致错误安全判断。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基准无法评估视觉-语言模型在真实工业CCTV场景（如灰尘、蒸汽、低光照、遮挡等恶劣条件）下的表现，缺乏针对工业监控的专用诊断基准。
AI.method: 从149小时工厂监控视频中筛选10,024个候选片段，经时间去重、类别平衡和可见性感知分层采样后得到1,345个密集标注片段。每个片段包含工人级别动作标签、PPE属性、空间上下文和安全规则标注，并设计了来源感知审计协议来检测标注来源对模型评估的影响。
AI.result: 未审计的VLM生成标注可使同系列模型准确率虚高17个百分点；最佳VLM（9个模型）行为识别准确率仅42.6%，人类基准为84.6%；37-58%的正确动作预测仍伴随错误安全判断；没有模型通过5项诊断检查中的2项以上。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉-语言模型在工业监控场景下表现严重不足，尤其在安全推理方面存在明显缺陷，且标注来源对模型评估结果有显著影响，需要建立来源感知的审计协议以确保评估可靠性。

title: Is the Geometry Doing the Work? An Operating-Point Audit of Hierarchy in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
comment: 52 pages, 5 figures, Under review at TMLR
summary: Whether a hyperbolic representation model uses its geometry cannot be read off its curvature parameter: what matters is the dimensionless operating point $\sqrt{c}ρ$ and whether the radial and cone machinery is active there. We develop a battery of necessary-condition diagnostics and audit three published hyperbolic vision-language families -- MERU, HyCoCLIP, and PHyCLIP -- across released checkpoints and controlled interventions on a fixed GRIT snapshot, identifying three failure modes. First, curvature is not an active resource: the operating point stays near-Euclidean ($H(u)\approx 1$; no audited converged checkpoint reaches $\sqrt{c}ρ>1$), and releasing the curvature floor moves curvature and norms but keeps the operating point near-Euclidean, without substantial downstream degradation. Second, the cone and traversal machinery is measured inoperative: entailment cones are inactive, saturated, or misaligned, and graded traversal fails under controlled readouts, while directed radial depth is a bounded non-detection above shuffle-null controls at quantified sensitivity; the one surviving native-relation residual remains non-operative. Third, hierarchy-looking evaluations are underdetermined: taxonomy correlations are carried by angular distance, and coarse-retrieval gains track box/compositional supervision, not curvature. A mechanistic account explains why: the entailment objective admits a low-curvature, wide-cone shortcut, and a parameter-free aperture identity (cones saturate iff $\sqrt{c}ρ\le 2K$) locates the edge where every entailment-trained unclamped run settles; entailment-off runs show no arrest there. The shortcut is the dominant accelerator of collapse, not its sole cause. These formulations, as released, do not instantiate the radial/cone mechanism their geometry motivates; we distill the audit into a five-number geometry report for future hierarchy claims.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对MERU、HyCoCLIP和PHyCLIP三个已发表的视觉-语言模型进行诊断，发现它们并未真正利用双曲几何的径向和锥体机制，其操作点停留在近欧几里得区域，且存在三种失效模式：曲率未激活、锥体和遍历机制无效、层级评估结果不明确。
AI.motivation: 检验已发表的双曲视觉-语言模型是否真正利用了其宣称的双曲几何特性，而非仅仅使用曲率参数。
AI.method: 开发了一套必要条件诊断工具，对MERU、HyCoCLIP和PHyCLIP三个模型进行审计，包括已发布检查点和可控干预实验，基于固定GRIT快照进行分析。
AI.result: 发现三种失效模式：1) 曲率未被有效利用，操作点始终近欧几里得；2) 锥体和遍历机制无效，包含锥未激活或饱和，分级遍历失效；3) 层级评估结果被欠定，分类相关性由角距离驱动。
AI.conclusion: 这些模型并未实现其几何动机所驱动的径向/锥体机制，存在低曲率宽锥的捷径。研究提出了一个五维几何报告用于未来层级声明验证。

title: Erasing Without Collateral Damage: Precise Concept Removal in Diffusion Models
summary: Training-free concept erasure is an attractive mechanism for controlling text-to-image diffusion models, but precise erasure often comes at the cost of damaging semantically related non-target concepts. Existing value-space methods remove the component of each cross-attention value along the target concept direction, implicitly treating target identity and shared visual structure as the same signal. We argue that this is the source of much of the collateral damage in prior preservation. We introduce CARE, a closed-form concept erasure operator that replaces the raw target direction with a kept-subspace-aware direction computed from a small bank of retained concept anchors. The resulting edit is applied directly in cross-attention value space, requires no model fine-tuning, and adds only a negligible offline computation. A single shrinkage parameter controls the erase-preserve trade-off. We further show that the operator admits a minimum-disturbance interpretation and, in its projection form, leaves the kept subspace invariant. Experiments under the standard concept-erasure protocol show that our method preserves non-target concepts more faithfully while maintaining competitive erasure across instance, style, and celebrity concepts. Code: https://github.com/parthupman/care

AI.tldr: CARE是一种无需训练的闭式概念擦除方法，通过保持子空间感知的方向替换原始目标方向，在交叉注意力值空间中直接编辑，更有效地保留非目标概念的同时擦除目标概念。
AI.motivation: 现有基于值空间的概念擦除方法将目标身份与共享视觉结构视为同一信号，导致擦除目标概念时严重损伤语义相关的非目标概念。
