AI.method: 提出CARE闭式概念擦除算子：从少量保留概念锚点计算保持子空间感知的方向，替换原始目标方向，直接应用于交叉注意力值空间，无需模型微调，仅需少量离线计算，通过单个收缩参数控制擦除-保留权衡。
AI.result: 在标准概念擦除协议下，该方法在保持非目标概念更忠实的同时，在实例、风格和名人概念上保持竞争性的擦除效果。
AI.conclusion: CARE具有最小扰动解释，其投影形式保持子空间不变，有效解决了概念擦除中的附带损伤问题。

title: ChatImage: Navigating Long-Form LLM Answers through Interactive Images
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce detailed answers to complex queries, but these answers are typically presented as dense linear text, which makes fine-grained inspection, navigation, and return visits difficult. We present ChatImage, a system that converts long-form LLM answers into interactive visual images. Given a textual answer, ChatImage first normalizes its content into structured visual modules, plans a visual layout, and renders a coherent image. It then applies a second grounding pass to the rendered image with vision grounding models such as LocateAnything and MiMo-Vision, with optional SAM-style mask refinement, to identify the visible regions that should support interaction. From these grounded regions, ChatImage overlays transparent clickable hotspots on the image. Each hotspot opens a detail panel and a region-scoped follow-up thread, allowing the user to inspect and query a specific part of the answer without re-reading the full response. Instead of treating planned coordinates as the final interaction geometry, ChatImage uses them as priors and grounds the interaction targets after rendering, which improves consistency between visual content and clickable regions. We release a reference implementation and introduce a 30-question benchmark covering infographic, map, and scene-based answer formats. Evaluation with configured external models reports interaction-loop completion, a strict visual-alignment gate, and a SAM-based mask-completeness diagnostic.

AI.tldr: ChatImage将LLM的长文本回答转换为交互式可视化图像，通过后渲染视觉定位技术实现点击热区，支持局部查询和细粒度导航。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的详细回答以密集线性文本呈现，难以进行细粒度检查、导航和回访。
AI.method: 1) 将文本内容规范化为结构化视觉模块并规划布局渲染图像；2) 使用LocateAnything、MiMo-Vision等视觉定位模型对渲染图像进行二次定位，结合SAM掩码精化；3) 在定位区域上叠加透明可点击热区，每个热区关联详情面板和区域级后续对话线程；4) 采用后渲染定位（而非预定义坐标作为最终交互几何），提升视觉内容与可点击区域的一致性。
AI.result: 发布了参考实现和包含30个问题的基准测试（覆盖信息图、地图、场景类答案格式），通过外部模型评估了交互循环完成度、视觉对齐门控和SAM掩码完整性诊断指标。
AI.conclusion: ChatImage通过后渲染视觉定位方法，有效解决了LLM长文本回答的交互式可视化问题，在视觉内容与交互区域的一致性上优于传统预定义坐标方法。

title: CenSynCMB: Centre Maps and Physics-Guided Synthesis for Microbleed Detection
summary: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) are MRI markers of small vessel disease and the microbleed component of amyloid related imaging abnormalities (ARIA-H), but their small size, sparsity, and similarity to vessels, calcification-like foci, and artefacts make automated detection difficult. We propose CenSynCMB, a centre-guided and mimic-aware framework combining a 3D Attention U-Net, auxiliary centre-map supervision, false-negative-driven reweighting, and fold-wise physics-guided synthesis of positive CMBs and labelled hard negatives. Synthetic data expose the detector to compact lesions and common mimics without validation or test leakage. On VALDO Task 2, CenSynCMB achieved the best local-comparison lesion-level F1 (74.3%, p = 0.020); on external AIBL SWI, it achieved the highest local-comparison recall (88.5%, p = 0.0058) and F1 (65.0%, p = 0.0016). Together, these results support scalable CMB candidate extraction in large, unlabelled MRI cohorts, while highlighting cohort-specific calibration as the next step toward reliable burden estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合中心引导、模拟感知和物理引导合成的CenSynCMB框架，用于自动检测脑微出血（CMBs），在多个数据集上取得了最佳检测性能。
AI.motivation: CMB体积小、稀疏、与血管、钙化灶和伪影相似，导致自动检测困难，现有方法难以有效区分真实CMBs与易混淆的阴性样本。
AI.method: 构建3D Attention U-Net，引入辅助中心图监督、假阴性驱动重加权以及逐折物理引导的合成数据生成（包含阳性CMBs和标记的困难阴性样本），在不泄露验证/测试数据的前提下增强检测器的判别能力。
AI.result: 在VALDO Task 2上取得局部对比病灶级F1为74.3%（p=0.020）；在外部AIBL SWI数据集上取得最高局部对比召回率88.5%（p=0.0058）和F1为65.0%（p=0.0016）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持大规模无标签MRI队列中的CMB候选提取，但需进行队列特定的校准以实现可靠的血肿负荷估计。

title: WildSplat: Feedforward Gaussian Splatting from Unposed In-the-Wild Images
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures; Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/wildsplat/
summary: While feedforward 3D reconstruction excels at efficient novel view synthesis, it typically falters when faced with scenes under varying illumination. To this end, we introduce WildSplat, the first feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework capable of appearance-conditioned novel-view synthesis for unposed in-the-wild images. To handle inconsistent photometric conditions, we propose a dual-branch architecture that explicitly decouples geometry from appearance. The geometry branch extracts an appearance-invariant 3D structure and jointly predicts camera poses. To govern the rendering appearance, the appearance branch injects target appearance cues into the content features via a globally pre-modulated cross-attention mechanism. To further prevent feature entanglement, we introduce a joint multi-reference training strategy that stabilizes the training process. Extensive experiments show that WildSplat surpasses existing optimization-based and feedforward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in in-the-wild novel view synthesis and appearance editing from sparse inputs in a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: WildSplat是首个前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架，能够在无位姿的野外图像中进行外观条件化的新视角合成，通过双分支架构解耦几何与外观，在单次前向传播中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式3D重建方法在光照变化剧烈的野外场景中表现不佳，无法处理不一致的光照条件。
AI.method: 提出双分支架构：几何分支提取外观不变的3D结构并联合预测相机位姿；外观分支通过全局预调制交叉注意力机制将目标外观注入内容特征；引入联合多参考训练策略防止特征纠缠。
AI.result: 在野外新视角合成和外观编辑任务上，WildSplat超越了现有的基于优化和前馈式方法，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: WildSplat成功实现了从稀疏输入的野外图像中，通过单次前向传播完成高质量的新视角合成和外观编辑。

title: Beyond Isolated Objects: Relationship-aware Open Vocabulary Scene Understanding via 3D Scene Graph Analysis
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment 3D scenes beyond predefined categories by transferring semantic knowledge from vision-language models. Existing methods have advanced this task by lifting language-aligned 2D features into 3D, yet they often rely on context-independent semantic representations, leaving object relationships underexplored for contextual refinement. We propose RelGraphOV, a relationship-aware framework that uses 3D scene graphs to enhance open-vocabulary 3D understanding. Our method constructs relational scene graphs from multi-view observations by leveraging vision-language reasoning to infer object relationships and prune geometrically implausible connections, without manual relationship annotations. To aggregate relational context while avoiding feature interference, we introduce an Adaptive Gated Dual-Stream Contextual GAT that separates dense geometric features and semantic CLIP embeddings, performs edge-guided message passing, and adaptively fuses complementary semantics. A hierarchical contrastive objective further promotes instance-level consistency and category-level discrimination. Experiments on ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, ScanNet$++$, and Replica demonstrate strong performance and generalization ability. Project Page: https://cxavireh.github.io/relgraphov-projectpage

AI.tldr: RelGraphOV提出了一种利用3D场景图增强开放词汇3D场景理解的关系感知框架，通过视觉-语言推理推断物体关系并自适应融合语义特征，在多个数据集上展现了强大的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法多依赖上下文无关的语义表示，忽略了物体间关系对语义细化的作用。
AI.method: 构建关系场景图，利用视觉-语言推理推断物体关系并剪枝不合理连接；提出自适应门控双流上下文GAT，分离几何特征和CLIP语义嵌入，进行边引导消息传递与自适应融合；采用层级对比学习目标。
AI.result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet++和Replica数据集上展示了强大的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模物体关系并自适应融合多模态特征，RelGraphOV有效提升了开放词汇3D场景理解的语义细化和泛化能力。

title: ReCal3R: Reliability-Calibrated Learning Rates for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction relies on a compact recurrent scene state to process long image streams in linear time and bounded memory. However, repeated updates can gradually corrupt this state, causing reliable historical information to be overwritten by noisy or ambiguous observations. We introduce ReCal3R, a reliability-calibrated learning rate method for recurrent 3D reconstruction. Instead of directly applying a candidate learning rate, our method estimates state token reliability from the maintained scene state and uses it to calibrate a candidate learning rate derived from token alignment, state reconstruction residual, and recent update pressure. The resulting token-wise learning rate interpolates between a conservative base rate and the candidate rate, suppressing aggressive updates on unreliable tokens while preserving adaptation to informative frames. Applied to CUT3R as a training-free calibration rule, ReCal3R reaches strong performance on long sequences in pose, depth, and reconstruction quality, including a 3.7$\times$ reduction in ATE, with comparable runtime and memory. Code is available at: https://github.com/Powertony102/ReCal3R.

AI.tldr: ReCal3R提出了一种可靠性校准的学习率方法，用于流式3D重建，通过估计状态令牌的可靠性来抑制对不可靠令牌的激进更新，在长序列上显著提升了位姿和重建质量（ATE降低3.7倍），且无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建中，重复更新会逐渐破坏循环场景状态，导致可靠的历史信息被噪声或模糊观测覆盖。
AI.method: 从维护的场景状态中估计状态令牌的可靠性，并用它来校准从令牌对齐、状态重建残差和近期更新压力导出的候选学习率，实现令牌级别的学习率插值，在保守基率和候选率之间权衡。
AI.result: 在长序列上的位姿、深度和重建质量方面表现优异，ATE降低3.7倍，运行时间和内存开销与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 作为CUT3R的无训练校准规则，ReCal3R有效提升了流式3D重建在长序列上的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: PixWorld: Unifying 3D Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Pixel Space
summary: 3D reconstruction and generation are commonly tackled by separate paradigms: pixel-based regression for reconstruction, and latent diffusion for generation. Recent works attempt to unify them in latent space, but with notable drawbacks: the diffusion objective is defined on latent features rather than the underlying 3D representation, and both branches suffer from information loss introduced by latent encoding, while requiring a pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) or Representation Autoencoder (RAE). In this paper, we reformulate these two tasks under a unified pixel-space diffusion paradigm and introduce PixWorld, a single model that jointly addresses 3D reconstruction and generation. By supervising diffusion directly on rendered images, PixWorld removes the above limitations and aligns optimization with 3D scene fidelity. Beyond photometric and perceptual supervision that operates at the 2D image level and lacks 3D geometric awareness, we further introduce a geometry perception loss that aligns rendered views with their ground truth in the geometry-aware feature space of a pretrained 3D foundation model, providing 3D structural supervision. PixWorld consistently outperforms prior latent-space generation methods and matches state-of-the-art reconstruction methods, demonstrating the superiority of a unified pixel-space approach.

AI.tldr: PixWorld是一个统一的像素空间扩散模型，通过直接在渲染图像上进行扩散监督，同时解决3D重建和生成任务，消除了潜在空间方法的信息损失，并引入了几何感知损失来提升3D结构监督效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将3D重建和生成任务分开处理（重建用像素回归，生成用潜在扩散），或统一到潜在空间但存在信息损失问题，且需要依赖预训练的自编码器（VAE/RAE），缺乏统一的像素级解决方案。
AI.method: 提出PixWorld统一像素空间扩散范式，直接在渲染图像上进行扩散监督；引入几何感知损失（geometry perception loss），利用预训练的3D基础模型在几何感知特征空间中对齐渲染视图与真实视图，提供3D结构监督。
AI.result: 在生成任务上持续优于先前的潜在空间生成方法，在重建任务上与最先进的重建方法达到同等水平。
AI.conclusion: 统一的像素空间扩散方法优于潜在空间方法，能够同时兼顾3D重建与生成任务的高质量性能，验证了像素空间范式的有效性。

title: MV-Forcing: Long Multi-View Video Generation via 4D-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled either long single-view generation through temporal autoregression, or short multi-view synthesis through bidirectional attention. However, generating long, multi-view consistent videos of dynamic scenes remains unsolved. In this work, we present MV-Forcing, a framework that composes temporal and view-wise autoregression within a single diffusion model by introducing a 4D geometric bridge between sequentially generated views. Our key insight is that an autoregressive 3D reconstruction model naturally interfaces between autoregressively generated views. Given a completed source view, we reconstruct its 3D structure and render a geometric prior of the next target viewpoint, which the diffusion model refines into a high-quality video. To extend generation beyond the teacher's fixed temporal window, we introduce a joint denoising regime where both view slots are initialized from noise during training, enabling temporally unbounded generation. We distill the model via Distribution Matching Distillation with Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing, closing the train-inference exposure bias gap for both temporal and view-sequential autoregression. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that MV-Forcing produces geometrically consistent multi-view videos of dynamic scenes at arbitrary lengths and viewpoint counts using a single few-step student model.

AI.tldr: MV-Forcing提出了一种通过4D几何桥接在单个扩散模型中组合时间和视角自回归的方法，能够生成长序列、多视角一致的动态场景视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型要么生成长时间的单视角视频（时间自回归），要么生成短时间的多视角视频（双向注意力），但无法同时实现长序列和多视角一致的动态场景生成。
AI.method: 在扩散模型中引入4D几何桥接，利用自回归3D重建模型在先后生成的视角之间建立几何先验；采用联合去噪机制（训练时两个视角槽均从噪声初始化）实现时间无界生成；通过分布匹配蒸馏和时空自强制策略缩小训练-推理暴露偏差。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，MV-Forcing能够使用单个少步学生模型生成任意长度和视角数量的几何一致的多视角动态视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过4D几何桥接和联合去噪机制，成功实现了长序列、多视角一致的动态视频生成，且支持任意长度和视角数量。

title: InFlux++: Real and Synthetic Data for Estimating Dynamic Camera Intrinsics
summary: Camera intrinsics are vital for recovering 3D structure from 2D video. However, most 3D algorithms assume fixed intrinsics throughout a video, an assumption that often fails for real-world in-the-wild videos. Consequently, estimating per-frame intrinsics from RGB images is critical for making 3D methods robust to videos with dynamic intrinsics. InFlux previously advanced this research direction by establishing the first real-world benchmark with per-frame ground truth intrinsics for dynamic intrinsics videos. Nevertheless, existing methods remain inaccurate due to two obstacles: (i) training data is scarce and lacks intrinsics diversity; and (ii) benchmarks, including InFlux, have limited scene and camera motion diversity, making it difficult to properly evaluate methods. To address both gaps, we present InFlux++, consisting of two components. InFlux++ Synth is a large-scale procedurally generated synthetic video dataset with 441K+ annotated frames from 1841 high-resolution videos, providing accurate per-frame ground truth intrinsics for training dynamic intrinsics prediction models; a subset also includes per-frame pose, depth, and normals. The videos feature rich intrinsics diversity through changes in camera zoom and focus, as well as dynamic objects and realistic rendering effects such as lens distortion and defocus blur. InFlux++ Real is a large-scale real-world benchmark that extends InFlux with 514K+ newly captured frames across 334 high-resolution videos, spanning a wider range of scenes and camera motions. Finetuning existing intrinsics prediction methods on InFlux++ Synth consistently improves focal length estimation across both InFlux++ Real and InFlux, suggesting that synthetic supervision is promising for RGB-based intrinsics prediction. For the dataset, benchmark, code, videos, submission instructions, and live leaderboard, please visit https://influx.cs.princeton.edu/ .

AI.tldr: InFlux++ 包含两个部分：InFlux++ Synth（大规模合成视频数据集，441K+帧，含动态内参、镜头畸变、散焦模糊等标注）和 InFlux++ Real（大规模真实世界基准，514K+帧，覆盖更广泛的场景和相机运动）。实验表明，在合成数据上微调现有方法能持续改进焦距估计效果。
AI.motivation: 现有3D算法通常假设视频内相机内参固定，但现实视频中内参往往是动态变化的。当前缺乏多样化的动态内参训练数据，且现有基准（如InFlux）场景和相机运动多样性不足，导致动态内参预测方法不准确。
AI.method: 提出 InFlux++，包含两个组件：(1) InFlux++ Synth：大规模程序化生成的合成视频数据集，含1841个高清视频、441K+标注帧，提供精确的每帧真实内参，包含变焦、对焦变化、动态物体、镜头畸变和散焦模糊等效果；(2) InFlux++ Real：大规模真实世界基准，含334个高清视频、514K+新采集帧，覆盖更广泛的场景和相机运动。
AI.result: 在 InFlux++ Synth 上微调现有内参预测方法，能够在 InFlux++ Real 和 InFlux 两个基准上一致地改进焦距估计性能。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据监督在基于RGB的内参预测方面具有前景，InFlux++ 为动态内参预测提供了更丰富的训练数据和更全面的评估基准。

title: SynCity 3000: Bootstrapping Scene-Scale 3D Diffusion
summary: We present SynCity 3000, a framework for generating 3D scenes that are globally coherent while enabling fine-grained layout control. Building on the ability of current image-to-3D generators to produce complex 3D assets from a single image, we extend this capability to the scale of entire scenes by adapting the generator to be applicable as a convolutional operator. We achieve this by fine-tuning the model on scene-like data generated by a new synthetic data engine, which we propose to address the scarcity of 3D scene data for training. The convolutional generator is then applied to a dimetric image of the entire scene, generated from the user prompt, resulting in 3D scenes of arbitrary size and complexity. Across diverse prompts and layouts, SynCity 3000 produces large, coherent, and detailed scenes, addressing the shortcomings of prior approaches to 3D scene generation.

AI.tldr: SynCity 3000是一个通过将图像转3D生成器改造为卷积算子，结合合成数据引擎，实现从用户提示生成全局连贯、布局可控的大规模3D场景的框架。
AI.motivation: 现有图像转3D生成器能生成复杂3D资产，但难以扩展到整个场景级别，且缺乏用于训练的大规模3D场景数据。
AI.method: 1) 提出合成数据引擎生成场景类数据以解决数据稀缺问题；2) 在合成数据上微调生成器，使其可作为卷积算子应用；3) 从用户提示生成整个场景的等距图像，再用卷积生成器生成任意规模和复杂度的3D场景。
AI.result: SynCity 3000能够在多种提示和布局下生成大型、连贯且细节丰富的3D场景，优于先前的3D场景生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了之前3D场景生成方法的局限性，实现了全局连贯与细粒度布局控制的兼顾。
